notes.title: Devlog #103: Co-Op Beta - Playtest Launch & Changelog
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 First Co-op Beta Playtest Releasing to Players[/h2][p]After months of testing and iteration, we’ve reached a version of the co-op mode that, while not perfect, is stable enough to be shared with players. This marks a huge milestone for the project — and your feedback and bug reports have played a critical role in getting us here. Thank you.[/p][p]This release is available as a [b]public_testing beta playtest[/b], and we encourage all notified players interested in multiplayer to give it a try. It’s still a work-in-progress, but we believe it’s good enough to start real gameplay and stress testing.[/p][p][b]We are already working on a hotfix update that addresses some of the most urgent known issues.[/b] We’re also preparing the next version of the update with more content and deeper systemic changes.[/p][p]This build doesn’t include everything we originally planned — it’s a compromise between overall stability and the need to [b]finally get co-op into your hands[/b].[/p][p]Over the last two years, [b]1,510 co-op–related tickets[/b] have passed through our tracker — covering bugs, suggestions, and task implementations. What you see in this devlog is only a small slice of what separates the last public version from this current co-op beta.[/p][p]In parallel, we’ve also worked through a large number of general improvements unrelated to multiplayer — including crash handling, graphics quality, stability, performance and other foundational systems.[/p][p]Many of those additional tasks are still in progress. Some of the things we’re building now won’t be visible until a month, two, or three from now.[/p][p][b]Thank you[/b] for your trust, feedback, and ongoing support. Let’s keep pushing this mission forward — together.[/p][p][/p][p]The Occupy Mars Team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🔧 How to Join and Host Co-Op Sessions[/h2][p]To access the Co-op Beta, you need to switch your game branch to [b]public_testing[/b] on Steam. [b]Important:[/b] If you haven’t previously signed up for the beta or participated in pre-EarlyAccess playtests, the co-op mode will not be working for you unless you sign up for the [b]Occupy Mars: Co-Op Playtest button.[/b][/p][p]How to activate the first co-op playtest:[/p][olist][*][p]Open [b]Steam[/b] and go to your [b]Library[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Make sure the product [b]Occupy Mars: Co-Op Playtest[/b] is visible in your game library.[/p][/*][*][p]Right-click on the main game - [b]Occupy Mars: The Game[/b] and select [b]Properties[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]In the left-hand menu, click the [b]BETAS[/b] tab.[/p][/*][*][p]In the dropdown labeled [i]“Select the beta you would like to opt into”[/i], choose: public_testing - public testing version[/p][/*][*][p]Close the Properties window — Steam will automatically download the beta version.[/p][/*][*][p]Once updated, the game should display [b]\[public_testing][/b] next to the title in Steam.[/p][/*][/olist][p]If you don't see the beta tab:[/p][list][*][p]Make sure you're [b]online[/b] in Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Try restarting the Steam client.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you launched the public_testing don't have the co-op buttons active in the game's main menu:[/p][list][*][p]Wait for the next batch of playtest invites as we scale up and let more martians in.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🧭 Starting and Joining Co-op Games[/h3][p]After launching the game, go to [b]Start Game[/b] → [b]Multiplayer[/b] (or click [b]Online CoOp (Beta)[/b]).[/p][p][b]To host a game:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Click [b]Create Game[/b]. While most settings are currently locked, you can:[/p][list][*][p]Choose the starting location.[/p][/*][*][p]Select a save to continue from.[/p][/*][*][p]Copy the [b]join code[/b] to share with other players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]To join a game:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Use [b]Search Game[/b] in the Multiplayer menu, or:[/p][/*][*][p]Choose [b]Join Game[/b] and paste the [b]lobby code[/b] provided by the host.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you're the host, you'll see a notification with the nickname of any player requesting to join.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]⚠️ Current Limitations of Co-Op Beta[/h3][p]The following features are [b]not yet available[/b] in this build:[/p][list][*][p]Kicking or banning players[/p][/*][*][p]Vote-to-kick system[/p][/*][*][p]Password-protected lobbies[/p][/*][*][p]Text or voice chat (chat is enabled in lobby only)[/p][/*][*][p]Custom game names[/p][/*][*][p]Weather events[/p][/*][*][p]Rover and Mars Truck[/p][/*][*][p]Some buildings and technologies[/p][/*][*][p]Antennas, drop events and pendrives[/p][/*][/list][p]Most of these features will be introduced in upcoming updates.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]💾 Saving and Hosting Notes[/h3][list][*][p]The lobby creator is the host. [b]Host acts as the server[/b]. If the host quits without saving — and no other player saved — progress will be lost.[/p][/*][*][p]Any player can create a save, and you can resume the game from any previously saved [b]co-op[/b] session from any player (not only from the host).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]👥 Inviting Friends via Steam[/h3][p]If you’re already in the game, you can invite your Steam friends through the overlay:[/p][olist][*][p]Press [b]Shift + Tab[/b] to open the Steam overlay.[/p][/*][*][p]Open a chat with the friend you want to invite.[/p][/*][*][p]Click the arrow near the message field and choose [b]Invite to Game[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Alternatively, paste the [b]session code[/b] directly into the chat.[/p][/*][/olist][p]This method works only if you’re hosting or already in a multiplayer lobby.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🛠️ Troubleshooting Multiplayer Issues[/h3][p]If you're experiencing crashes, desync, save/load issues, or connection problems, please follow these steps:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Send log files to[/b]: [url="https://eracolonisthelp@gmail.com"]eracolonisthelp@gmail.com[/url][/p][list][*][p]Logs are located at:
[i]C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\PyramidGames\\OccupyMars\\Player.log[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Logs are [b]overwritten with each game launch[/b]. Send them [b]immediately after the issue[/b], before restarting. If you forgot once, there's a copy of previous log in [i]Player-prev.log[/i] file.[/p][/*][*][p]The game stores logs from the [b]current[/b] and [b]previous[/b] session.[/p][/*][*][p]Please [b]identify which log is from the host[/b] (contains the most data) and which from the clients.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]If the issue is tied to a save[/b], attach it:[/p][list][*][p]Save location: 
[i]C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\PyramidGames\\OccupyMars\\SaveData[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Zip the [b]entire folder[/b] of the affected save and send it to the email above, along with a short description.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Describe the issue clearly[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]What happened? When?[/p][/*][*][p]What were the host and each player doing at the time?[/p][/*][*][p]Can the issue be reproduced?[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Where to report[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Steam Community [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/8/"]Co-Op Playtest Bugs & Issues [/url][/p][/*][*][p]Discord [url="https://discord.com/channels/649192095080513569/1357493579341103325"]Mars Coop Discussions[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Email (recommended for anything that requires attachments) [url="https://eracolonisthelp@gmail.com"]eracolonisthelp@gmail.com[/url][/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]✨ New Features & Improvements in v0.226[/h2][p]General Content[/p][list][*][p]Added dirty variants for Outpost decorations to enhance realism.[/p][/*][*][p]Added dust accumulation on loot found in Outposts.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved build bounds handling for interior structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visual quality of weather effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved general responsiveness of in-game interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Prepared additional models for interior and exterior decorations.[/p][/*][/list][p]Co-op Specific Features & Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Added multiplayer online Co-op game mode[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented player inventory synchronization for improved stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new ID system to ensure consistent player handling in co-op sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced Playfab Party integration for a more reliable multiplayer backend.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled connection status messages for players joining co-op sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added synchronization for oxygen usage from buildings, backpacks, and life support systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled synchronization of bottle filling from control panels.[/p][/*][*][p]Integrated synchronization systems for the battery rack and heavy suit.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented co-op support for centrifuge mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Deployed shared loot mechanics for co-op players.[/p][/*][*][p]Rolled out global loot spawning system for Outposts.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced synchronization for cable animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Integrated unlock conditions for decorations and tech tree elements in co-op.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced co-op version of the technology tree.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled automatic decoration unlocks at co-op game start.[/p][/*][*][p]Developed enhanced authority management system for co-op sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added essential co-op information panel/pop-up for players.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented new, more friendly UI for co-op and other game modes in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented handling for various network disconnection scenarios (e.g., cable unplug, router restart).[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for keyboard and gamepad navigation in the co-op lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced synchronization of avatars for non-friend players (WIP).[/p][/*][*][p]Applied refined design updates to sleeping panels.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🛠️ Fixes & Changes[/h2][p]🛠️ High Priority Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed problem with disappearing tracker’s colours.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where dust devils could affect the player even when inside a warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where assembling Rocket A Kit caused the player’s hand to become bugged.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed miner allowing to unload resources into a container that was already full.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several crashes cases that occurred during game launch.[/p][/*][/list][p]🔧 Normal Priority Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Optimized LODs and fixed missing materials in cracks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with clothing items duplicating unexpectedly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with double rock spawning caused by terrain generation system.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weather effects being visible while the player was inside.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with night vision not turning off properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing home button on the tablet interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect estimation of sleep duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed edge case where player had access to night vision despite not unlocking it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing rock drilling particles from other players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where some rocks lacked physics.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed small levitating object from the environment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inventory box requiring double ESC press to close.[/p][/*][/list][p]🧹 Low Priority Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect slot numbering for workshop structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing black backpack in player customization.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility of PCB parts on zoom screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🐞 Known Bugs[/h2][p]⚠️ Major Issues[/p][list][*][p]Resource amount desynchronization (water, oxygen, electricity) may sometimes occur when players use tanks or batteries separately — especially when refilling suits manually from sockets. [i](We have a fix ready, but it affects core systems and requires extended testing.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Players may still experience issues with joining, rejoining, being disconnected, kicked to lobby, or game crashing — both during game launch and active sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Plant state issues during replanting — either by hand or using crates — especially when stacking previously separate plants. [i](Hotfix is ready and will be included in the first minipatch.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Items may occasionally disappear from inventory boxes, refrigerators, or storages. [i](Likely fixed — patch coming in the first minipatch.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]In single-player mode, centrifuge only works while the player is actively looking at its panel. [i](Hotfix already prepared — included in the first minipatch.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Some clients may load into the skybox or spawn far from the base after reconnect.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare cases of invisible or partially loaded player models.[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠️ Other Known Issues[/p][list][*][p]Temperature, oxygen level, or UI indicators may desynchronize between players.[/p][/*][*][p]Differences in plant states between host and clients (e.g., wilted vs. healthy).[/p][/*][*][p]Character appearance may differ from selected setup (e.g., wrong hairstyle or color).[/p][/*][*][p]Deathboxes may appear under terrain or in unreachable locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Grinder or tool interactions may trigger "null" errors on certain objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Rejoining players may spawn hundreds of meters from the intended respawn point.[/p][/*][*][p]Shared use of fridges, printers, or panels can lead to UI glitches or lag.[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle controls or camera may behave erratically in some situations.[/p][/*][*][p]In rare cases, players fall under the terrain, lose movement, or get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby host may occasionally switch unexpectedly. [i](Rare)[/i]*[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]💬 We're Listening[/h2][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy playing together on Mars. As always, we’re monitoring feedback actively on both [b]Steam Community[/b] and our [b]Discord server[/b] — don’t hesitate to reach out if you run into issues or want to share your thoughts.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy testing, Colonists![/p]

notes.title: Devlog #102: Publisher Sale and Co-Op Beta Progress Update July
notes.content:
[h3]Dear players! We’ve got a handful of announcements for you today.[/h3]

🌍 [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/PLAYWAYPUBLISHERSALE2025]PlayWay Publisher Sale[/url][/b] kicks off today and will last until [b]August 7th, 2025[/b] — with special discounts on all our major titles. Occupy Mars is also discounted! This might be your [b]last chance to get to Mars at a lower price[/b]. 

🎮 We are also releasing our fresh [b]July Co-Op Beta Progress Update[/b]. This time, it’s looking better than ever! Grab a coffee and let’s dive into what we’ve been working on!

[h3]🛰️ July Update – Co-Op & Countdown[/h3]

We’re slowly preparing to launch the long-awaited [b]Co-Op Playtest[/b]. As you probably know, the history of space exploration is also a history of waiting, fixing, and… waiting again. Game development isn’t all that different. But now — it looks like we finally have a [b]window of opportunity[/b], and we’re entering the final stretch. There’s a decent chance we’ll surprise you with something special during this Publisher Sale. 

🧑‍🚀 We're full of hope — recent internal tests have been going well, and momentum is finally on our side.  
But as any astronaut will tell you: [b]a mission isn’t started until the rocket actually leaves the launchpad[/b].

🚀 Just ask [b]Sławosz Uznański-Wiśniewski[/b] — the second Polish astronaut and CERN engineer — whose recent mission to the ISS was [b]postponed seven times[/b] before finally launching on [b]June 25th, 2025[/b].

🙏 [b]So keep your fingers crossed and stay tuned — we’ll keep you updated as soon as we’re ready for the countdown.[/b]

[h3]💡 Heads up, Astronauts![/h3]

This is also one of the best moments to grab Occupy Mars - because, after the co-op update is launched, the base price of the game will be slightly increased. As we get closer to full release the Earth and Mars are slowly drifting apart — and interplanetary travel gets more expensive. 

Another important information is that we will be phasing out the old Occupy Mars: Prologue version which was released in 2020. So much has changed over the years that it no longer represents the game in any way. We also want to focus 100% on the main game and we realized that we won't have the manpower to support the prologue. 

But fear not! aside from the co-op mode and more content which is planned [b][url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars]on our roadmap[/url][/b] we have a new idea to integrate a "challenges mode" into the main game, which would provide goals similar to those from the Prologue. It's going to be great!

[h3]🎁 Kickstarter backer?[/h3]

Don’t forget: if you supported us during the Kickstarter campaign, you have access to an [b]exclusive spacesuit[/b]. Soon, it may become visible to others… 😉

[h3]🎉 Amazing Discounts![/h3]

Meanwhile - the publisher sale has started - here's a sneak peek 👀 at the discounts we prepared for you:
🚀 Occupy Mars: The Game - 35% off!  
🎁 Occupy Mars: Supporter Pack - 35% off!  
🦕 Dinosaur Fossil Hunter - 55% off!  
🦖 Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Raptor DLC - 55% off!  
🎨 Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Designer DLC - 55% off!  
🔧 Rover Mechanic Simulator - 75% off!  
⚙️ Rover Mechanic Simulator: Perseverance Rover DLC - 75% off!

[b]🚂 Don’t miss this opportunity to expand your Steam library! ✨[/b]

And don’t forget about the [b]Bundles[/b]📦 You can get even better discount by purchasing games together! 

📦 Examples: 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31567/Pyramid_Games_Bundle/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28017/Occupy_Mars_Universe_Bundle/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26972/Occupy_Mars_Collectors_Edition/
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?sort_by=_ASC&developer=▲+Pyramid+Games&category1=996]...and more! [Click here to see all of our bundles][/url]

[b]Happy gaming and stay tuned! 🎮[/b]
The Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Devlog #101: Co-Op Beta Progress Update June🔧
notes.content:
[h1]Co-Op Devlog: Tech Tree is In, Fixes Continue, and Steam Sale Live! 🌱🛠️[/h1][p][/p][h3]Hello Martians![/h3][p]
We’re back with another devlog to keep you in the loop as we continue improving and expanding Co-Op mode. There’s some great news this time — a long-awaited feature has finally made its way into the game… and it changes a lot![/p][p][/p][h3]🧪 Co-Op Tech Tree is Now Functional[/h3][p]We’re happy to confirm that the [b]Tech Tree now works in Co-Op mode[/b] — and it’s a game changer!
Players can now [b]earn experience and unlock new technologies together[/b], but it also revealed how many systems are interconnected — scanning, drilling, growing plants, recycling, and even sleeping can all impact tech point generation.[/p][p]We’ve already implemented the core synchronization and fixed several edge cases — like points only going to the host, or desynced XP values between players. We’re still refining balancing and interactions, but overall… it's working, and it’s fun![/p][p]This also means Co-Op is feeling more like [b]a full-featured game mode[/b] now — not just a sandbox playground.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 Fixes & Progress Update[/h3][p]We’ve addressed a broad range of issues in the past week, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]Stuck players after respawn or save/load scenarios[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Invisible players, broken interactions or ghost items[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Desynced incubators, plants growing at different speeds[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Issues with grinding, planting, or harvesting mechanics in multiplayer[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera bugs, incorrect UI states, or “skybox” glitches[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We’re still working on polishing more subtle bugs — like occasional desyncs with cables or panels not updating correctly for all players. Some systems are being reworked to better support Co-Op logic long-term.[/p][p][/p][h3]🛰️ Co-Op Rollout Plan[/h3][p]We’re inching closer to opening up multiplayer testing to more players. Once internal builds reach the stability we’re aiming for, we’ll begin inviting groups to participate in public tests. As before, Co-Op will eventually launch as a free update for all owners of the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Steam Sale – 40 % Off Right Now! 🔥[/h3][p]The Steam Sale is live, and Occupy Mars is currently 40 % off. If you’ve been thinking about grabbing the game — or gifting it to a friend you’d like to explore Mars with — now’s the perfect moment.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thanks for Following the Mission 🚀[/h3][p]Every week we’re getting closer to completing the Co-Op upgrade. It’s a lot of work behind the scenes, but your feedback, patience and enthusiasm make it absolutely worth it.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be back soon with more news — stay safe, stay curious, and keep watching the Red Planet.[/p][p][/p][p][i]– Occupy Mars team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #100: Co-Op Beta Progress Update May🔧
notes.content: [h1]Co-Op Devlog: Solid Progress, System Fixes and One Step Closer[/h1][p]Hey Martians! 👋[/p][p]Our internal Co-Op testing is steadily moving forward, and we’re excited to share the progress with you. While developing multiplayer for a complex sandbox like Occupy Mars is no small feat, we’re seeing real momentum — and this build brings us another big step closer to public testing.[/p][h3]🔧 Key Systems Polished in This Build[/h3][p]This week’s internal update focused on stability, synchronization, and multiplayer logic across various systems. Here’s what we’ve improved:[/p][p]🛏️[b] Sleep system stability:[/b] We fixed many edge cases involving sleep mechanics — progress not triggering, incorrect max durations, interruptions caused by low oxygen/water despite having enough, and camera or UI issues during interactions.[/p][p]💾 [b]Save/load reliability:[/b] Improved spawn positions, inventory loading, session syncing, and addressed bugs with saves not overwriting properly.[/p][p]🔌 [b]Cable & pipe syncing:[/b]  Floating plugs, desynced cables, blocked interactions — now cleaned up and syncing correctly between host and clients.[/p][p]🧰 [b]UI & interaction fixes:[/b]  ESC/menu/board interactions work reliably again. No more getting stuck while configuring setups or trying to accept requests.[/p][p]🌐 [b]Multiplayer connection stability:[/b] Better handling of joins, rejoins, and complex in-game actions like simultaneous saves or crash-recovery. More reliable all around![/p][h3]🔧 Still in Progress[/h3][p]We’re still fine-tuning a few of the trickier bugs:[/p][list][*][p]Plug and connector desyncs in very specific scenarios[/p][/*][*][p]Rare disconnects when 3rd player joins or rejoins[/p][/*][*][p]UI issues during rapid saving or loading by multiple players[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛰️What’s Next? [/h3][p]Once we’re confident in the build’s stability, we’ll invite small test groups to help us stress test the systems in real-world gameplay. When ready, Co-Op mode will be released as a free update for all existing Occupy Mars players.[/p][h3]Thanks for Your Support 💛[/h3][p]We’re nearly there. Thanks for being patient while we build a rock-solid multiplayer experience. See you on Mars (with your crew) soon! [/p][p][i]Occupy Mars team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #99: Co-Op Beta Progress Update🔧
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow Martians! 👨‍🚀👩‍🚀[/h1]

[h1]Co-Op Progress Update: Major Fixes & Internal Testing 🚀🔧[/h1]

While Co-Op Mode is not yet available publicly to players, our team is actively working behind the scenes to ensure a smooth and stable multiplayer experience. Internal testing is ongoing, and we've been making solid progress—thanks to dozens of detailed test sessions.

[h3]What’s Happening Right Now? 👨‍💻👩‍💻[/h3]

Our [b]internal QA and dev teams are working closely together[/b], tracking down network-related bugs, improving session stability, and refining gameplay mechanics. Multiplayer testing takes more time than usual due to the [b]complexity of real-time synchronization and networking issues[/b], but we’re committed to getting it right.

[h3]Top Priority Fixes We've Made So Far 🛠️[/h3]

[b]🔹 Disconnections & session freezes[/b]
We’ve resolved several [b]critical crashes and disconnections[/b], especially those that occurred during sleep, when joining existing games, or when interacting with devices.

[b]🔹 Inventory sync & item loss bugs[/b]
Common problems like [b]empty inventories after loading[/b], [b]vanishing items[/b], or mismatches between players' inventories have been fixed in the latest internal builds.

[b]🔹 Sleeping issues & animation loops[/b]
The notorious [b]infinite sleep loop bug[/b] and related animation issues have been addressed — no more eternal naps on Mars. 😉

[b]🔹 Vehicle-related glitches[/b]
Issues such as [b]falling through terrain after exiting vehicles[/b], [b]jetpack disappearing mid-air[/b], and visual bugs with broken vehicles have been corrected.

[b]🔹 World loading and terrain bugs[/b]
We’ve made improvements to [b]outpost visibility, terrain generation after loading[/b], and various placement issues that were previously disrupting the experience.

[h3]When Will Players Get Access? 🧪[/h3]

We’ll continue to invite groups of players who signed up for the [b]co-op playtest[/b] to help with [b]stress tests and further debugging[/b] as soon as the Co-Op build reaches a stable internal milestone. After playtests, once we’re confident in the performance, [b]Co-Op Mode will be released as an update[/b] to all existing owners of Occupy Mars.

[h3]What Else Will Be Included? 📦[/h3]

The Co-Op Update won’t just bring multiplayer — it will also include [b]critical bug fixes[/b], [b]quality of life improvements[/b], and [b]some smaller new features[/b] to the base game. We’ll share more details in the full changelog closer to release.

[h3]Thanks for Your Patience ❤️[/h3]

We know you’re excited — and so are we! Thank you for sticking with us and supporting the project. Co-Op takes more time and effort to get right, but we’re getting there. Stay tuned for more updates, and keep an eye on our [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars]official roadmap[/url] to follow development progress.

See you soon on Mars (with friends)! 🌕

Take care,
[i]Occupy Mars team[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #98: Occupy Mars: Co-op Beta is Coming – Watch the Trailer Now! 🚀
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow Martians! 👨‍🚀👩‍🚀[/h1]

The long-awaited Co-op Beta is getting closer to launch, and we’re beyond excited to share more details with you. So, without further ado — you can watch the new Co-op trailer below! 🎥🔥

[previewyoutube=DIBPjwGT5kc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Survive. Build. Explore. Together. 🎮[/h3]
For months, we’ve been working hard to bring multiplayer mode to Occupy Mars and we can’t wait for you to experience it. Whether you're constructing your base, gathering resources, or troubleshooting power issues, everything's better [b]with a crew[/b] at your side! Co-Op mode will let you and your friends [b]explore the Red Planet together[/b], facing challenges as a team and making survival even more rewarding.

[h3]Join Our First Co-Op Stream! 🚀[/h3]
Want to see Co-op Mode in [b]action[/b] before it launches? Mark your calendars! 📅
[b]🛠️ When?[/b] March 6 at 5:00 PM CET
[b]📍 Where?[/b] Steam, Twitch & YouTube
Our [b]dev team[/b] will be going live to [b]stream the co-op mode gameplay for the first time[/b]. This is your chance to see how multiplayer works, give suggestions, and get behind-the-scenes insights. Make sure to tune in and join the chat—we’d love to hear your thoughts and questions!

[h3]Become a Co-Op Beta Tester! 🛰️[/h3]
Excited to try Co-op Mode early? On [b]March 6[/b], alongside our live stream, we’re also launching a [b]sign-up process for Co-op Beta Testers[/b]! It will be a playable but limited version with some features disabled. Each week we will let more and more people in, and we will collect detailed feedback which will help us refine the gameplay. Expect more details about the signup process in the next devlog.

[h3]Special Co-Op Celebration Discount! 🔥[/h3]
To celebrate the upcoming Co-op Mode, we’re offering a [b]special price drop -35% off[/b] on Occupy Mars—only [b]until March 20[/b]! This is the last time the price will be so low, as we are working on more content to be released later this year, making the game bigger and better. So if you haven’t joined the adventure yet, now is the perfect time to grab the game at a discount and get ready for co-op fun! Or–make use of the promotion and gift the game to a friend you'd like to Occupy Mars with!

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
The whole team is focused on the Co-Op Update and we’ll share more details as we get closer. Stay tuned for more updates, check our [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars]roadmap[/url], and don’t forget to follow our social media channels to stay in the loop. The future of Mars is multiplayer, and we can’t wait to see you arriving with a Team! Everybody on board! 🚀 

That’s all the information we wanted to share with you today. See you on Match 6th! Over and out! 🌕

Take care, 
[i]Occupy Mars team[/i]

P.S. You may have noticed some improved visuals in this trailer, more about this in the next post 😉

notes.title: Winter Update is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians![/h1]

Today we are releasing another update - the ❄️ [b]Winter Update[/b] ⛄!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/f75291680087c70d6845bd710030196aef8d7880.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/a699290b366900fbb9ab86022b4066e18b0469db.jpg[/img]

[b]💾 Before you start the game, we recommend making a backup of your save files as a precaution.  🔄 While nothing should go wrong, it's always better to be safe and ensure your progress is protected 👍[/b]

If no major issues are reported we will switch it to the default branch in a few days.

[h2]Winter Update Highlights ⭐[/h2]

It's a pretty big update with a long list of changes and improvements. Among many changes and bugfixes we have also added some of the "Quality of Life" features many of you have asked about. 🎉

[h4]📈 Infinite Technologies[/h4] 

A new feature which allows you to spend XP points even if your Tech Tree is maxed-out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/8e050c9e6723e27f8761349f556f0a69d4401cef.jpg[/img]

[h4]🗺️ Rover Map[/h4] 

It's now possible to open the tablet's radar (map) while sitting in the chair driving!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/c6a349055593b757470fad25246f0eba865e2b02.png[/img]
[h4]🦾 Improved Grabber Tech[/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/e4a1c480a9e6c67680ec754e587b67654ea3fbc9.png[/img]
[h4]🛠️ Hangar opener[/h4] 

The long-awaited outside hangar lever is now added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/227dd0b453e9db6c8ab897608656576a5e41aa2e.png[/img]
[h4]📌 Even more target points![/h4]

While the Anniversary Update added more colors, you wanted even more, so now you can add multiple target points with the same colors! (but they're fresh, so sometimes you'll have to color a point again)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/b61bbfe8dd12f17c1207c424fbf04a683615f40a.jpg[/img]
[h4]🌬️ Control the speed of Airlocks[/h4] 

Another highly requested feature.
some want them slow, some want them fast... 
there's now a checkbox for that! 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/8a4702cc4acad7ac14c485ac832ac512732742a7.jpg[/img]

[h4]☃️ Winter Decorations![/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/1ca806281c9f5d08f6e070d735b905fbdf85ab5b.jpg[/img]

There are still a few known issues left which we hope to iron-out soon, they are not super critical but we wanted to let you know what to avoid just in case 😉➡️

Happy Halloween, and enjoy exploring with a festive twist! 🎃 Thanks for being part of our incredible community on Mars!

Yours,
[i]Occupy Mars team[/i]

notes.title: 0.185.0 now available on public_testing!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow Martians![/h1]

How’s the Anniversary update discovering going? How do you like it so far? It’s been 2 weeks since we released it, but don’t let it discourage you, we would still love to hear from you! 💬💖

Today we’re coming with another patch, containing many bugfixes, based on your reports. 🐛

[b]Before you start the game, we kindly recommend making a backup of your save files as a precaution.  🔄💾 While nothing should go wrong, it's always better to be safe and ensure your progress is protected 👍[/b]

[h2]Changelog 0.184.3 -> 0.185.0 public_testing[/h2]

See the changelog we’ve prepared for you, below:

[h3]List of bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Significantly increased suit charging speed when using small solar panel (not applicable on Madman)
[*] Fixed player being stuck in tablet
[*] Fixed player blocking in rover's inventory screen
[*] Fixed game locking while driving
[*] Fixed player not being able to use workbench
[*] Fixed inability to keep grinding after the point in minigame disappeared 
[*] Fixed inconsistency in outposts' textures
[*] Fixed disappearing jetpack
[*] Fixed wrong info on water detector lvl3 screen
[*] Fixed hanging trailer in hangar
[*] Fixed player losing oxygen in base after grinding parts of it
[*] Fixed  incorrect view on electricity tab on radar
[*] Fixed constantly increasing electricity points
[*] Fixed "Continue" button allowing to start loading old saves
[*] Fixed event follow issues
[*] Fixed tank pack decoration coming back after save/load
[*] Fixed rock merging with another rock
[*] Fixed freeze in introbase after scrubber explosion in TPP
[*] Fixed item spawning under the outpost
[*] Fixed magenta in introbase in explosion scene
[*] Fixed shockwave magenta
[*] Fixed missing blueprints and technologies 
[*] Fixed no keybind assigned to spectral detector by default [AZERTY]
[*] Fixed missing various keybinds [AZERTY]
[*] Fixed missing colliders in airlocks
[*] Fixed missing landing capsule collider
[*] Fixed various translation issues
[*] Fixed blinking texture in outpost
[*] Fixed various UI issues
[*] Fixed disappearing vehicles after death
[*] Fixed sleep loop animation
[*] Fixed grinded probe coming back after save/load
[*] Fixed black tools in FPP
[*] Fixed grinder animation wiggling too quickly
[*] Fixed targeting of increase speed points
[*] Fixed  incorrect translation in tutorials [all languages]
[*] Fixed no voice of journalist NPC near the TV
[*] Fixed rock blocking marstruck
[*] Fixed cables and pipes appearing in player's hand without pressing corresponding button
[*] Fixed dropping O2 bottle causing it hover in air 
[*] Fixed overlapped text in tutorial panel

[*] Fixed issue with scanning rocks
[*] Fixed inconsistency in building recipes for big antenna in big crusher and building mode

[*] Fixed some items falling behind seats in capsule making them unable to pick up
[*] Fixed too low default position of transformer ghost

[/list]
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new music
[*] Added automatic disable of rover's lights
[*] Added new sorting connections priority method
[/list]
If you’d like to try the patch, you’ll need to change the branch on Steam, which is easy-peasy! 🍋 Check the instructions we provide below and find out for yourself.

[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Antennas not having reach until the save/load

[*] Player getting stuck in truck’s container

[*] Display issues on ultra-wide monitors

[*] Empty water source in sink, even though the building has water provided
[*] Various issues with room system (eg. external oxygen and pressure reaching maximum levels after exiting the capsule and closing the door)

If you encounter any issues or have concerns while playing version 0.185.0, feel free to reach out to us through our social media channels. We appreciate your feedback, as it helps us improve the gaming experience. 🎮 Your input is valuable, so don't hesitate to share any thoughts or observations. Thanks for being part of our community! 📱💬

notes.title: Devlog #92 - first Anniversary update patch!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow Martians![/h1]

It’s been a few days since the release of the Anniversary update. We’re no less excited than you are! Today, we’re coming to you with a first patch, containing hotfixes for the most often reported bugs and known issues. 

[h2]Changelog 0.184.2 -> 0.184.3[/h2]

[h3]List of bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with being unable to pick up the bottle from CO2 scrubber with auto-fill option enabled
[*] Fixed issue with infinite filling of oxygen bottle in CO2 scrubber
[*] Fixed rover sinking under the terrain making it impossible to drive after resetting it from the vehicles tab level
[*] Fixed issue with disappearing circuit board from the broken quad after loading the save
[*] Fixed doubled probe appearing and other issues related directly to it
[*] Fixed minimum required amount of sleep being shown too late
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/31460179/4398eb3e605abcacaf79e4c0978f640b65b57f7b.png[/img]

Update the game and try it out. 

And as always, if you encounter any issues or concerns during the gameplay, don’t hesitate and let us know! We appreciate every single report. And we continue working on next patches.

See you on Mars!

yours,
[i]Occupy Mars team[/i]

notes.title: The Anniversary Update is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow Martians! [/h1]

It’s been a while.

We know that you were waiting for too long, and so were we. During this time, we’ve been following every single thread, reading every post and message on our social media, Discord and Steam forums. These were very different, some of them kind and supportive, other ones painfully honest. 😅

Thank you for each of them! This way we knew what to focus on, and also that there are a lot of people waiting for this update. This devlog is dedicated to all of you our loyal astronauts! 🧑‍🚀

[b]So... fasten your seatbelts, put your helmets on, because here it comes, the Anniversary update![/b] 🚀

The Anniversary Update brings many revolutionary changes to core gameplay aspects, including survival mechanics, electricity system, building system, player animations, HUD, scanning, decorations and much more. We can’t wait for you to dive in and explore everything that’s new. 🔎

However, we want to be upfront with you. While this patch brings some exciting new content, we’re aware that it’s not yet perfect. That’s not an excuse, but a kind of a compromise; we know that it took us a long time to release this update, so today we’re sharing a reasonably stable version, but there are still some areas that need refinement. Thanks in advance for your bug reports, we will investigate them as they arise. The hotfixes are coming!

[h2]Important information before you launch the game[/h2]
[quote]We’ve been announcing this in previous devlogs but we want to confirm that because of changes to core gameplay aspects the Anniversary Update [b]does not support saves from previous game versions.[/b] We're sorry about that, we know that many of you have built incredible bases. If you wish to continue playing on your old save files [u]you can always switch to old game version[/u] using the Steam game properties (Betas tab):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/4535f96fce90abc2eacd3f7639cd7922a667325e.jpg[/img]

You will find many past versions there such as builds from Exploration Update or Nuclear Update. This way you can always keep playing and expanding your bases. We hope that the reworked game mechanics will be worth it and that dropping save compatibility won't be required again in the future.

We believe, that the new features and content will compensate for this inconvenience well and that it will be worth starting over. We’re waiting for screenshots of your new, upgraded bases!
[/quote] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/16d558747227d6a5fe174971e7ff6be3c8a0eba2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Anniversary Update | Changelog v0.160.2 -> v0.184.2[/h2]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added possibility to build battery rack in the lobby
[*] Added possibility to remove unwanted notifications from the list
[*] Plants can now be collected all at once with one click 
[*] Building antennas will let you see what weather phenomenon is incoming
[*] Lack of sleep now affects health and stamina
[*] Vehicles other than rover can now be covered with a dust after the sandstorm too
[*] It's possible to mix different types of plants on fields now
[*] Added more building coloring on the radar for easier differentiation of building's health 
[*] Added short descriptions for locked blueprints
[*] Changed number of slots in incubator and pot to make them consistent
[*] Destroying a composter will now result with throwing loot out
[*] Removed internal energy storage for rover and truck. Battery is always required.
[*] Buildings can now be repaired instantly with a dedicated repair kit
[*] Vehicles can now be repaired instantly with a dedicated repair kit
[*] Added new type of outposts and items inside of them
[*] Added new functionality to the spectral detector - furniture and decorations scanning
[*] Added display of target point names on HUD (consistent with name in radar)
[*] Added ability to take the helmet off when crouching
[*] Feet are now snapping to the uneven terrain
[*] Rover charge level is now visible from the outside on the HUD
[*] Fuses added to building requirements
[*] The sleep timer panel has been changed
[*] Implemented new video-tutorial system
[*] Added interactable sockets inside of buildings to facilitate building process - take the blowtorch out, point it on the coin-like icon and the list of devices that can be build in this place will show up
[*] You can now add furnishing to your base!
[*] Added "Cleaning Nanobots" to the tech tree for instant-cleaning solar panels
[*] Added printable decorations and decoration variants mechanics
[*] Greatly improved water bottle refilling, you can refill every bottle at once no matter if bottles are in your suit slot or inventory. Added option to automatically move bottle after refiling to inventory
[*] Added pop-up window for in-game devlog note
[*] Added adjustable weather effects duration
[*] Fuses can now be burned if too much powers is given
[*] Added possibility to print circuit boards
[*] Added search bar to the blueprints menu in tablet, inventory and knowledge base
[*] Added feature to reset player when stuck
[*] Added buildable launchpad
[*] Added fullscreen mode to rover remote controller
[*] Added tooltips in main menu for freeplay starting items
[*] Added targeting minigame for drilling rocks, building and grinding
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added electronic board to big miner
[*] Improved save system (lower probability of disappearing/returning rocks, bases and objects)
[*] Improved building placement and snapping 
[*] Improved lights in domes
[*] Improved game balance (experience, tech tree, players parameters, starting loot, and more!)
[*] Significantly sped up airlock opening
[*] Broken quad and landing capsule can now be grinded with grinder lvl 2 or 3
[*] Improved animations e.g. running, crouching, rotation in place, tool usage, tool changing, backward diagonal walking 
[*] Oxytree is now producing more oxygen

[*] The hydration system has been changed. Now you have 2 bars that show water-related parameters - water level in the bottle and hydration level. Even when you run out of water in the bottle assigned to your suit, as long as the hydration bar (the bottom one) is not red you are safe. 
[*] Changed GUI and added labels to CO2 Scrubber's  valves
[*] Improved electrical system, values in each device are numerical, no more percentages!
[*] Now sockets also have their priorities - connect the most important objects to the socket with the lowest number. Also - the update time has been changed to 1 minute in-game.  
[*] Improved corridor panels
[*] A weather customization option has been added (how often weather events will occur and how long they should last at most - you can even choose to turn off weather events, but then don't count on achievements). The length and frequency of weather phenomena has also been rebalanced

[/list]

https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/4261049898200059363

As you can see, that was a lot of work. A significant portion of the changes we've implemented involved a complete overhaul of the core game mechanics. This isn't just a matter of adjusting a few values in a spreadsheet; it requires rewriting large sections of code, including additional code revisions and corrections due to the possible ripple effects. Each correction also needs to be tested in a proper way. And finally, we've developed entirely new game mechanics for features that didn’t exist before. 

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
[b]High[/b]
[list]
[*] Items previously transferred from printer inventory to the container are gone. Workaround: do not use advanced management of the crusher’s inventory until we fix that. The basic management should be safe.
[*] Can't pick up the bottle form CO2 scrubber with auto-fill option enabled. Possible workaround: save/load the game and you’ll be able to pick it up
[*] Tutorial not displaying properly after interacting with the elevator in the alpha base
[*] Various translations missing or incorrect
[*] Incorrect notifications after completing quests in campaign

[*] Wrong info on water detector lvl 3 screen (change mode to fix that issue)
[*] Minigame: cannot keep grinding after disappearance of the point
[*] Various issues with scanning and stacking decorations
[*] Issues with merging MRE
[*] Disappearing jetpack after startup, resulting in the player falling from the sky. Workaround: don’t save your game while flying, jetpack only disappears when you save/load the game after taking off.
[*] Issue with targeting the chair in the landing capsule
[*] Increasing electricity exp points, while they shouldn’t grow
[*] Weather effects affecting player in some places  of closed outpost
[*] Various issues with interactions with cabinets in particular type of outpost
[*] "Continue" button allowing to start loading old (incompatible) saves
[*] After demolishing one of the base’s structures, the NaN value will appear on the screens of any devices that show water data,  control panels in buildings, UI, on the radar,  pump stations etc. Workaround: save/load the game.
[*] Disappearing circuit board from the broken quad after loading the save. Possible workaround: to put the new circuit board inside of the ATV,  simply save/load the game. The destroyed one won’t be back, though. 
[*] Infinite filling of oxygen bottle in CO2 scrubber
[*] After resetting the rover from the vehicle's tab level, the rover sinks under the terrain making it impossible to drive. Workaround: save/load the game.
[*] Doubled probe, only one left after save/load
[*] After interacting with doubled probe, ESC menu doesn’t work. Workaround: save/load the game
[*] Minimum required amount of sleep is shown too late. Workaround: if the sleep button is not responsive, simply set the sleep time to later
[/list]
[b]Medium / Low[/b]
[list]
[*] Blinking texture in specific type of outpost
[*] No collider in airlock for a specific type of outpost
[*] Scrap 3in1 tanks can be grinded with grinder lvl1 when being inside of the hangar
[*] Disappearing vehicle after player's death
[*] Missing collider in landing capsule
[*] Various issues with text on the UI
[*] Crusher's lever broken animation 
[*] Visible motocross' open electricity socket while driving
[*] Reappearing probe after being grinded  after save/load
[*] Unpleasant grinder animation
[*] Disappearing light in motocross from distance
[/list]
We're currently working on an update to address this issues. Please don’t forget that Occupy Mars is still in its Early Access phase. Early access is more than just a label; it’s a vital part of our game’s development process. It means that while it is playable and full of exciting content, it’s also a work in progress. But most importantly, it means that you, our players, have a direct influence on each update.

Your feedback, ideas, and suggestions are what inspires us to push forward, make changes, and continue improving. Every update is shaped by your input, and we’re incredibly grateful for your continued support. We’re creating this project together. 

Alright, no more boring speeches! Let’s go and try the update already! 
We just can’t wait to see what you think about it!

Yours, 
[i]Occupy Mars Team[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #90 Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martians![/h1]

In this devlog we want to let you know about the progress of work on the upcoming Major Update. 

This upcoming update is revolutionary in many ways and as such requires thorough testing. Our hope is that this update will answer to many reported issues and feedback we have collected during the first year of Early Access. We are working hard on testing the build, but as of today it's not yet ready for release, even to public_testing branch, but we will let you know as soon as it's possible.

Due to changes in the core game mechanics it was hard to predict how long some those features will take to implement, so we prioritized those which take the most time first and divided this update into parts. Here's what we have achieved so far ([b]Anniversary Update - Part #1[/b]):

[h2]Animations[/h2]
[olist]
[*] We have improved player animations - it's not perfect yet, but you should notice many improvements in the quality, smoothness and responsiveness of the animations. During first launch of the new version, you will be shown the new game settings screen where you can adjust gameplay to your preferences. Hand animations will be disabled by default, so that default gameplay is even faster.

[*] Overall responsiveness should be better. Our goal was to get rid of the feeling of "controlling the astonaut" and instead to achieve better feeling of "being the astronaut". 🤖 

[*] We have improved using tools and targeting, now grinding small objects will no longer be a problem and drilling should be easier both in FPP and TPP modes.🔨

[*] The mechanism of opening the airlocks was overhauled, it is now much faster, and the automatic doors are almost instant allowing for smoother gameplay while running between base sections.💨

[*] Positions of doors and cupboards are now saved, we've also fixed doors and cupboards, which were opening again after closing. 🚪

[*] We have fixed astronaut’s feet colliders which were a little bit too high + now each feet stands independently on the ground when placed on different heights and the player will step over small obstacles instead of requiring a full jump - this also makes the astronaut feel more alive. 🥾

[*] Improved tablet opening animation and position. We have also made it possible to open the tablet and take helmet off while crouching - as requested 😉
[/olist]

[h2]Electricity & Balance[/h2]
[olist]
[*] We have made huge changes in electricity & substance flow system - no more thinking about percentages when splitting power, from now on - only numerical values! Also: now outlets have priorities - the lower the ordinal number of an electrical outlet, the higher the priority (same applies to pump splitter).⚡

What does it mean in practice? For example: if your electricity input drops then it will not cut off every connected building but instead it will supply energy first to socket #1, then if it has enough power - to socket #2 etc. Many of you have requested this change and we hope you will enjoy it. This should allow for easier energy management while also opening new possibilities. 🔢

[*] Be careful about connecting electricity to buildings - if you transmit too much power to one outlet - the external fuses will burn and you will have to replace them. 🔌

[*] Electricity & Substance Flow System have been rewritten for more accurate and faster flow calculation.  They will now be refreshed every 1 in-game minute instead of previous 10 in-game minutes. Also now only the amount of energy/water actually used by connected building is consumed, instead of everything that's set as the socket output🌀

[*] Added new detailed infopanels with advanced information about electricity and substances to devices like ECU Transformer, Battery, Pump Station etc.🪫

[*] We have changed buildings costs, positions, electricity usage and overall balance of the game.📊

[*] We've also changed Early Game balance: faster tech tree progress and less grind at early stages.🪚

[*] Stack size of many items have been changed to make more sense. 📐
[/olist]

[h2]Construction[/h2]
[olist]
[*] We have added technology for printing circuit boards. This functionality will be moved to special workbench in future update, but for now this technology will enable printing circuit boards using 3D printers. 📟

[*] Added new mechanic: Decorations - scanning furniture and decorations in abandoned bases using additional mode in "Spectral Detector" tool will let you use them for decorating your own base using new "Cordless Drill" tool. Unlock different variants of furniture and decorations and place them where you want.🛋️

[*] We've improved building placement and snapping to grid and other buildings.🏭

[*] Added short descriptions for In-game locked blueprints.💳

[*] Added a special repair kit for buildings and vehicles - so you can instantly repair vehicle or a building.🛠️

[*] We've made it easier to build inside buildings: if you equip a welder you'll be shown a list that tells you what you can build on a given slot; if you prefer to build by selecting a device from the blueprints tab - no problem, we've added a marking that shows on which slot you can place it as well.🪑
[/olist]

[h2]Survival changes + hydration & oxygen rework[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Double progress bars on HUD for Oxygen, Hydration and Stamina - in the new version the bottle system will change. When the water bottle runs out you still have additional hydration level bar to know how long you can survive until the bottle is refilled. When your oxygen bottle runs out then there's a little bit of oxygen left in your suit which is shown by the thinner progress bar at the bottom. The Stamina bar also has second thinner bar which shows your Tiredness (maximum stamina regeneration level).🧴📊

[*] Added options to disable or change weather duration and effects in the Freeplay Start Menu 🌪️

[*] Sleep deprivation will now cause damage, but Astronauts can sleep during the weather events! (we had to implement sped-up weather-damage simulation during sleep to achieve this)🧑‍🚀

[*] We've reworked the bottle refill system while also adding auto shut-off to sinks after water is replenished to prevent water waste.💧

[*] We have added technology to unlock, to automatically refill the oxygen bottle from environment when inside.🫁
[/olist]

[h2]Plants[/h2]
[olist]
[*] From now on you will be able to mix different plant types in single device, like: shelves, fields, incubators and domes! 🌱

[*] We have finally converted the plant breeding facilities - they all now have an equal number of plant slots for easier replanting ⿻

[*] Trees will finally start to act like real trees - after harvesting fruit, the tree does not disappear, but continues to bear fruit (if you get bored with the tree - use the grinder to get rid of it) 🌳

[*] It's also now possible to collect all plants to the plants crate with one click. 🖱️
[/olist] 

[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Hotbars are now visible in all inventories and containers.🔨

[*] Added search and sorting options to tablet: Blueprints menu, Inventory and FAQ! 🔍

[*] We've modified CO2 Scrubber and Battery Rack UI to make them more intuitive and easier to use.🖥️

[*] We've improved the grading of colors on the map to have better control over the condition of your buildings.🗺️

[*] We've improved the target points - now you can have more colors and their names from the map are displayed above the target point on HUD.📍

[*] We've have made changes in the Tech Tree and added additional technologies like: "Cleaning Nanobots" for automatic cleaning of solar panels.💻

[*] We have moved rear camera of rover behind the HDS Arm.📹

[*] Rover and Truck now also require battery and oxygen bottle to build, they also require charging after construction.🚚

[*] We have improved optimization, now there are much smaller FPS drops while driving.⌛

[*] We have added new types of abandoned outposts.🏚️

[*] We have moved Quick Load to F9 - it will be harder to miss-click quick save and quick load. ⌨️

[*] Added new video-tutorial system to the game.🎬

[*] Hundreds of bugs fixed! 🪲

[*] We are adding main purpose quest to the Freeplay Mode 🚀 (more details about it later 😉)

[*] and much more! 🎇
[/olist] 
🚀 That's not all of the changes, as we still have many tasks to add and implement, but first we want to stabilize the build with the core changes mentioned above. Join our Thursday development stream on Twitch and YouTube where we'll be showing some sneak peaks and talking about those changes in detail.

[hr][/hr] If you missed the 🌟Steam Summer Sale remember that there are still many bundles available which allow you to get our games cheaper while also helping us with the development of updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31567/Pyramid_Games_Bundle/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28017/Occupy_Mars_Universe_Bundle/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?sort_by=_ASC&term=occupy+mars&category1=996]Click here for full list of game Bundles[/url] available together with Occupy Mars!
[hr][/hr] 

[b]Thank you very, very much for your continued support! 🙏[/b] 

Take care,
[i]Occupy Mars team[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #89 v0.160.2 now available on default branch!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martians! 🚀[/h1]

It’s been a few weeks since we launched update v0.160.2 to the [i]public_testing[/i] branch on Steam. We wanted to collect your feedback and opinions before spreading it to a wider audience, but there it is!👍

[h3]Nuclear Update | Changelog v0.154.4 -> v0.160.2[/h3]
[b]For a full list of v0.160.2 fixes read the previous devlog #87:[/b] 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/4188985962637427870?l=english
[b]🛈[/b] As we mentioned in one of the latest devlogs, v0.160.2 is the last patch for the [b]Nuclear Update[/b] ☢️ and the next one will be the (quite revolutionary) [b]Anniversary Update[/b] 🎉 Our devs are doing their best to deliver it as soon as possible, so leave them a dose of encouragement in the comments below! 🙌 

[b]The Anniversary Update[/b] will bring a lot of changes in the core gameplay aspects, survival mechanics, building and repairing aspects, player animations and much more. For this reason please remember that there will be no save compatibility after v0.160.2, but we will (as always) first put the Anniversary Update on the public_testing branch to let you test it and have a choice before it goes live for everyone.👌

[b]⚠️ [u]Keep in mind that there are some known bugs in the version v0.160.2[/u] ⚠️[/b]
Although they are not very serious, we wanted to let you know about two of the issues that were reported by the players and possible ways to go around them ➡️

[b][u]Bug #1[/u][/b]: 
Rover's crane with a grabber sometimes doesn't react to player's commands to be opened or closed. 
[b]Temporary workaround[/b]: Change crane's tip to drill and change back to grabber. 

[b][u]Bug #2[/u][/b]: 
Rover inventory container’s UI is not showing the last three rows and it’s impossible to scroll down to see them using a mouse. 
[b]Temporary workaround[/b]: it’s possible to access those items from the invisible part of the inventory with arrows of your keyboard. Navigate to the bottom with the arrow down, press ENTER on the chosen slot and navigate back up with arrows to move the item from there. Press ENTER once again to place the item in the desired slot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/8c490621090f337f551079a82dadc952e6f11514.gif[/img]

We're already working on fixes as part of the Upcoming Update so those shouldn't occur in the future!🤞

[b]Branch changes[/b]

We have also reorganized Steam Beta Branches. With more updates it was becoming more and more difficult to track which version is on which "previous" branch. So now every important version is labeled as a separate Steam Beta Branch so you can always go back to the one you want 😉 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/f0cd110796cbdf9190ee024e5d639a9ceb6cc347.png[/img]

[h2]Aside from Mars...[/h2]

As you know - the game development industry is small and developers tend to know and help each other. This time we wanted to let you know that our friends from Game Island are releasing their new survival game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610520/Serum/]Serum[/url][/b]. 
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/31460179/eba0f066fe89689b860ed8ad9a4264218f58307e.gif[/img]

[b]Their Early Access will go live today![/b] In the game your ultimate goal is to find the precious 💉 Serum, essential to keep you sane and alive!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610520/Serum/

To celebrate their launch, in cooperation with Game Island and Toplitz Productions, we have prepared a special [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41851/]Stay Alive Bundle[/url][/b]! You can now get both, Occupy Mars and Serum, at a reduced price! 💵

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41851/

Give Serum a go and let its devs know your feedback - they'll appreciate it! 

And that's all for today! Thank you for your continued support and see you soon in the Major Update! 🖐️

Take care,
[i]Occupy Mars team[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #87 Update v0.160.2 live on public_testing!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear community, fellow Martians!🚀[/h1] 

It’s been a while since the latest patch release, but here we are! Introducing the newest update, now available on public_testing branch! 🤩🌟

[h3]Changelog v0.154.4 -> v0.160.2 (public_testing)[/h3]

We’re thrilled to announce that along with this patch we’re officially closing the ☢️ Nuclear Update chapter and from now on, we’re focusing exclusively on the 🎉 Anniversary Update. We have high hopes that it will result in accelerating the progress significantly. 

❗️If you’d like to try the newest patch, it is required to change the branch on Steam to public_testing❗️

[h3]How to switch branches? [/h3]

[*]Improved techtree points balance
[/list]

If the bug or idea you submitted isn't visible on the list, it doesn't mean we ignored it. Each report is carefully reviewed and placed accordingly in our task queue for analysis and further action. 🐞🔍

And that’s it! Thank you to those who were waiting more or less patiently for this update. 😊 We know it took a while, but because we value quality, we could not release a build that did not meet our requirements in testing, also most of the team is now focused on the bigger changes & new content for the upcoming Anniversary Update. 🛠️👷‍♂️

As always, we strongly encourage you to visit our social media and to sign up to our Discord channel. Let us know about your 💡 ideas for content development, share your 🎮 gameplay experiences and notify us about any 🐛 bugs you encounter. 

Thank you for your continued support and take care! 👋

Regards,
OM team

notes.title: Game Discount, plans and new bundles!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians! 🚀[/h1]

Welcome to another Devlog! ✍️

In this post we'll tell you about our plans for the next months, but also we wanted to let you know about current discounts and new bundles, especially interesting for those who haven't played our game yet.

[b][u]1st information[/u]: Development Update[/b]. We are currently testing the next regular update which fixes some bug reports and improves mechanics of [b]Nuclear Update[/b]. Next we will be focusing on the big changes for the upcoming [b]Anniversary Major Update[/b] to be released according to our [b]Roadmap[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/20dd6230e673d8b9f0ad5343af7a875bcb799fad.png[/img]

Our first goal for the [b]Anniversary Update[/b] is to address the most commonly reported pain points such us removing jerky movement, [b]improving input responsiveness, animations & targeting[/b]. The next goal for this update is a [b]big save system rework[/b], which will finally fix the problems with re-appearing items, objects falling through floor or floating above the ground. 

Another benefit will be that we will finally change the [b]% electricity calculation to kWh[/b] and improve the [b]building placement and snapping[/b]. It will also enable door position saving. We were waiting with this save refactor until now because it will render current game saves incompatible with future version, but we believe it will be worth it. This change is also essential before we introduce the Co-Op Mode.

That's not all, far from it! The refactoring will also touch the greenhouses and domes [b]allowing to plant different types of plants[/b] in the fields together and we want to unify the numbers of slots between the incubator, shelves and fields.

[b]Content[/b]-wise, we also have big plans for this update, but we will see how much we are able to implement before summer, so in terms of the list of [b]new additional content[/b] - let it stay as a mystery for now... 😉

[u][b]2nd information[/b][/u]: thanks to [b]Steam Dinos and Robots Festival[/b] Occupy Mars is now [b]25% off[/b] and our previous games: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864700/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter/][b]🦕 Paleontology Simulator[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864680/Rover_Mechanic_Simulator/][b]🤖 Rover Mechanic Simulator[/b][/url] are both [b]50% off[/b]!

[u][b]3rd information[/b][/u]: from time to time other studios contact us to create [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?sort_by=_ASC&term=occupy+mars&category1=996]Bundles[/url][/b] together with our game, which let you get other exciting games together with Occupy Mars with additional [b]📦 bundle discount[/b]: 

🔴[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1931730/Fort_Solis/]Fort Solis[/url][/b] is a story-first thriller / walking sim game located on Mars made by another Polish studio:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37097/Occupy_Fort_Solis/

🏹[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159420/Robin_Hood__Sherwood_Builders/]Robin Hood Sherwood Builders[/url][/b] is a new game by our friends from MeanAstronauts releasing today:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39066/Occupy_Sherwood/

❄️[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1394960/Winter_Survival/]Winter Survival[/url][/b] is an upcoming survival game made by our friends from Drago releasing next week:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39274/Occupy_Winter/

[b]▲ Pyramid Bundles:[/b]

We don't post this too often, but since this post is mostly about discounts it's a good time to remind you about bundles with our other games as it's the best support we can get to keep developing this game.

[b]Pyramid Games Bundle[/b] is currently the [b]best deal[/b] for those who didn't yet purchase all of our games:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31567/Pyramid_Games_Bundle/

[b]The Universe Bundle[/b] consists of games in the same Universe as Occupy Mars (so RMS and its DLCs):

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28017/Occupy_Mars_Universe_Bundle/

[b]Have fun on the 🔴 Red Planet! [/b]

Yours,
Occupy Mars team

notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians! 🚀[/h1]

Thank you for feedback regarding the newest version of the ☢️ Nuclear Update, [b]0.152.10[/b]! 
We are very grateful to you for sharing all those bug reports and suggestions. 😊

Today, we're excited to announce that the fresh build for the Nuclear Update just landed on Steam public_testing and nuclear_update_preview branches! 🔥👏

[h3]Changelog 0.152.10 -> 0.154.4 (public_testing & nuclear_update_preview)[/h3]

This was challenging time for our devs, they needed to face the issues with saving the game (also the one related to sleeping 😴), taming sandstorms that lasted too long and much more! 💪🔧

For full list of bugfixes and implemented features, take a look below. 📋

notes.title: Devlog #83 - Nuclear Update's first patches
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martians! 🚀[/h1]

The Occupy Mars team is very grateful to you for the overall positive reception of the ☢️ Nuclear Update! We've been closely following your feedback, keeping the developers updated with reported bugs, and we're happy to announce that, as a result, today we can bring you another update with fixes. 👏

[h3][b]Changelog 0.152.7 -> 0.152.10 (public_testing and nuclear_update_preview)[/b][/h3]

We've focused on 🛠️ fixing the most critical bugs, including the one with the well, and we've also improved the sandstorm 🌪️ system a bit, since you've often reported inconveniences related to this particular event.

[b]What we have fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] incorrect pump input value 
[*] discrepancy between the value given by the well and the spectral detector
[*] bug with hanging in the air after save reload
[*] excluded small miner to be received in a supply drop
[*] shortened sandstorm event duration 
[*] improved notifications about sandstorm event 
[/list]
If you encounter any issues or have concerns while playing version 0.152.10, feel free to reach out to us through our social media channels. We appreciate your feedback, as it helps us improve the gaming experience. 🎮 Your input is valuable, so don't hesitate to share any thoughts or observations. Thanks for being part of our community! 📱💬

We are currently testing another update with [b]even more changes and improvements[/b], so hopefully the next one will be stable enough to be released on Steam default branch, as well as on [b]Epic and GoG[/b] but for that we still need some time, so thank you for your patience. 😊

Looking forward to see you in the next devlog... 

... [b]or during today's stream! 📺 Join us for some gameplay, discuss the latest update, and relax with fellow Martians![/b] 🤜🤛

📅 25-01-2024
🕔 5:00pm CET
🌍 Twitch and YouTube

Take care,
OM team

[h1]Greetings Martians! 🚀[/h1] 

[h3]The Nuclear Update v0.152.7 went live on nuclear_update_preview branch![/h3]

This is for all of those who couldn't wait anymore - switch to the beta branch on Steam and have fun. But first, let's have a little sneak-peek 👀of what's waiting for you and watch the brand-new trailer 🎬 below:

[previewyoutube=Sxjif03Y2So;full][/previewyoutube]
❕❕ The new update is now available on both [b]nuclear_update_preview[/b] and [b]public_testing[/b] branches on Steam. ❕❕

We have decided to release it on the beta branches first because we want to gather your feedback 💬 regarding any bugs, and most importantly, [b]the necessary balance and economic changes[/b] following the introduction of new mechanics. 

Although we've been testing it for some time, this version [b]may contain bugs 🐛 so[/b], just in case, please first [b]backup your save files[/b] located in: 

[code]C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\LocalLow\PyramidGames\OccupyMars\SaveData[/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/9df63c94a48894d2fea46bccd825794173aee2d8.png[/img]

And finally, let's take a look at a full list of bugfixes and implemented features! To summarize the most important ones, we have prepared a graphic 📷, bringing them all together:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/46277f9367f6d8892263107e8340c7894e3e779a.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #81 even more Nuclear Update news!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martians! 🚀[/h1]

We are ready to reveal more news that the upcoming Nuclear Update ☢️ contains for you. You have already learned what supply drops are and how they work. One of the next special events you may encounter during gameplay is:
[h2]Probes🛰️[/h2]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/31460179/98dce30ba3fcc2f17c514dae8f097e2efbdd92cd.png[/img]
Keep an eye 👀 on your tablet; sometimes you might receive a signal from a probe. If you choose to follow the signal, a dedicated tracking point 📍 will appear on your screen. The event is not time-limited, so you don't have to rush, but hey, who doesn't want to reveal the mystery already? 😏

[b]Probes contain pendrives which are small electronic devices carrying technology data.[/b]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/31460179/51c99ca9345ec461687dbedff70cbcee74929a95.jpg[/img]
You can get it out of the probe and insert it into the corresponding science bench. The bench will decode the pendrive and you will be rewarded with experience points. 💡 You can use any bench you want or have access to, but using the appropriate one will give you the most experience points, so choose wisely!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/31460179/c5cfb82ef53efaeec36690c178e8fa76bd42a240.png[/img]
We've also added two additional [b]Historical Sites[/b] - Mars3 lander and Mariner probe. So get ready to go on an expedition and try to find them. And if you're a kind of photographer soul - take a screenshot 📸 of them, we'd love to see it!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/4c4ec7890b0c91a67d7a22a0e226bb68e66bd2fc.png[/img]
That's all for today, but not all in this update! Check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3870345512628476526]previous devlogs[/url], stay tuned for more information about the upcoming update and feel free to share your thoughts with us by anytime simply hitting F4 during the gameplay or writing to our support address [url=mailto:eracolonisthelp@gmail.com]eracolonisthelp@gmail.com[/url] 🎮

Take care,
Occupy Mars team

notes.title: Devlog #80 Nuclear Update news
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martians![/h1]

The upcoming Nuclear Update ☢️ hides new features and mechanics - but what are these? As promised, we're going to reveal the mystery, step by step in the devlogs, and this is one of them! 

[h2]🚀 Supply Drops[/h2]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/31460179/f7ab46b372ac02a187e44346ca195dbd790a53a0.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/31460179/2df3214319e6c2ee97a60355d46e791fbefc8897.jpg[/img]
You can now expect packages 📦 of essential equipment and resources from the E.R.A. If there is a supply drop scheduled somewhere in your area, you will get a notification. Follow the coordinates from notification 📍 and see what's inside! 🗺️

[h2]🚀 Automated Miners[/h2]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/31460179/37ea6b8962a2f2355a03272c2c8c9ce863cab174.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/31460179/850d5fbadcf4c99cf2664a28e013e4b83c0f8331.png[/img]
There are small and big Miners - both were designed to facilitate the mining ⛏️  process by retrieving the resources straight from underground sources. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nLNLR8DD/ezgif-com-optimize.gif[/img]

Use the new functionality of your spectral detector ([b]which needs to be upgraded to lvl 3[/b]) or the Heavy Rover ([b]unlock new technology to use it[/b]) to scan your surroundings in search for resource spots and build the automated miner* in the most convenient place. 
*[i]Miners require uranium rods to work.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/812d229e98d8c43dea263ea536d2ef2512b5fc4a.png[/img]

We will show you more features in upcoming devlogs, so stay tuned! 
All brave colonists aboard and see you next time! 👋

Take care,
OM team
