notes.title: v0.142.8 live release!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Martians![/h1]

We are super grateful for your commitment and willingness to test the latest version on the public testing branch. 😍

After several days of actively monitoring and analyzing your feedback regarding version 0.142.8, we are happy to say that no major problems have occurred and thus, it can be enjoyed by all players [b]on the default branch[/b]. 🥳

[h3]0.142.8 public testing -> default[/h3]

This version mainly focuses on [b]improving game performance, general quality of life and bugfixes[/b]. We also strongly encourage you to dive into game's video settings and find the configuration that's the most convenient for you.

[b]Note: we do know that there are still major FPS drops when riding the vehicles. We're still working on that, thank you for your understanding.[/b]

Speaking about the optimization and FPS rate, we also wish to remind you about the poll on our Discord channel. [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/649192095080513569/652886291687669760/1171420183462686800][b]Click here[/b][/url] to access our Discord server and to vote. 📊✔

Below you can see the list of other improvements, features added and known bugs.

[b]Which features were added[/b]:
[list]
[*] Vegetables stay 100% fresh within an hour of being harvested
[*] Possibility to take tool directly from the workbench after its upgrade or repair
[*] Weather forecast notifications in tablet's message tab
[*] Improved visibility of list of resources and added info about all materials owned while building
[*] Automatic rocket assembling on the workbench
[*] Autodrive for vehicles* [i](* To activate the autodrive, press G)[/i]
[*] Possibility to add more food-related buildings in the greenhouse: food processing unit, fridge and botany workbench*
[i]* This feature will allow you to place indoor equipment such as a fridge, botany workbench and food processing unit in the greenhouse.[/i]
[*] Extended list of items that can always spawn in the abandoned bases 
[*] Empty seed magazines being deleted after fully used 
[/list]
[b]What we have fixed[/b]:
[list]
[*] Changed game save backup location
[*] Issues caused by assembling many rockets on a few workbenches simultaneously
[*] Loading some kinds of ore to the truck could kill the player
[*] Player could die when running into rock while using jackhammer
[*] After grinding storage or fridge, MRE is not given back to player
[*] Game exits to Windows while loading items from save file (corner case)
[*] Continue button not clickable in tutorial 0 (corner case)
[*] Saving game with circuit box and board opened results with deleting the board
[*] Unable to get off the ATV (corner case)
[*] No passage to the lobby from rebuilt connector after tornado
[*] Game freezing right before going to sleep (corner case)
[*] Rover's door opening partially
[*] Game freezes inside of the rover
[*] Blocked interactions after picking the jetpack up inside the base
[*] Nothing is visible in the material tech tree
[*] Can't pull cable through Olympus
[*] Lower production on pump display when large tank is connected
[*] Destroyed vehicles respawn as fully functional
[*] Airlock partially opened, need to crouch to get out
[*] Storage cabinet can be placed on the seed machine
[*] Issues with interacting with objects
[*] After destroying the inventory box with empty seed containers inside, they are given back to inventory, fully filled
[*] Using survival kit makes the game crash
[*] Unity fatal error
[*] Random game crashes
[*] Building materials which were put in the hotbar are not displayed in the requirements while building
[*] Disappearing motocross
[*] Stucked in truck
[*] Sleep animation looped
[*] Game asks to re-do the quest which has already been done
[*] No terrain after decompression
[*] Helmet stuck in player's hand
[*] Unable to take out grinder in tutorial 2
[*] Difficulty with attaching the trailer to the rover
[*] Incorrect water amount displayed on building info screen
[*] Blocked interactions after pulling cable through rover
[*] Map stays active after switching off and doesn't let player to interact with other items
[*] When removing the airlock, oxygen disappears from the base
[*] Boards and blueprints spawning under the terrain
[*] Issues occurring due to setting wrong badge size
[*] Heavy suit doesn't need battery or be recharged to protect from outside conditions
[*] Disappearing translations in the main menu in Russian ver.
[*] Shadows have no head in FPP when helmet is taken off
[*] Hole in the big crusher
[*] Broken fuse texture
[*] All previously scrapped abandoned bases are back on map after loading save
[*] Greenhouse machine symbol on texture
[*] Antennas on terrain are indestructible
[*] Improved visibility of skip button in tutorials
[*] Typos in knowledge base in polish ver.
[*] Interactables objects are shown from too far away distance
[*] Poor waste tank's texture on fantastic 
[*] Night Vision can be used without a helmet
[*] Blowtorch II has the wrong name in German ver.
[*] CO2 scrubber display graphical issues 
[*] Temperature icon is blinking despite having protection from cold perk
[*] ATV not movable after hitting the solar panel 
[*] Difficulty with entering the truck
[*] Need to stop to crouch
[*] If tablet was opened without previously closing the ECU display, the ECU window will stay on the tablet screen
[*] Input value on pump panel is different than water production in well
[*] "Expand all" in FAQ not translated in russian ver.
[*] Naming and tracking target points can be activated on the tablet screen while using other tabs
[*] Wrong punctuation in polish ver.
[*] Cable dropped from hand when connected it to both small and big crusher
[*] Vehicles seem to smoke while driving
[*] Graphical issues with capsule adapter building process 
[*] Flashing texture on mini crusher's building ghost
[*] Repair kit cannot be moved by LMB from printer inventory
[*] While writing F4 feedback, night vision turns on and off while hitting N on the keyboard
[*] Multiple canisters of the same seed type being deleted when one of them is used
[*] Lack of fuses in the Greenhouse
[/list]
[b]Known bugs[/b]:
[list]
[*] Some models of usb joysticks seem to block the game after landing when starting a freeplay mode [i](if such rare case occurs on your PC- please disconnect the device)[/i] 
[*] When grinding storage containers, the game does not return the items which were inside the container to the player
[/list]
Plans for the incoming months include working on the most critical bugs and releasing the [b]next major update[/b]. Nevertheless, if you have any questions or suggestions, please write to us on our social media or at eracolonisthelp@gmail.com 

If you want to continue your gameplay on previous version, please enter game properties, beta tab and choose "previous".

We're also thrilled to announce our participation in the annual [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/3830935844785147913][b]Steam Awards[/b][/url], so if you haven't yet cast your vote in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/3830935844785147913][b]Best Game You Suck At[/b][/url] category, we encourage you to take Occupy Mars: The Game into consideration!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/3830935844785147913]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/4ade9ca743f8d0304d0d6d1d40879c56a64a8b84.png[/img][/url]

[b]Thank you very much for every single vote casted and for feedbacks regarding the newest version! We do create this game together![/b]

Take care,
OM team

notes.title: v0.142.8 available on public_testing!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians![/h1]

On the public_testing branch you will find a brand-new, fresh [b]version 0.142.8[/b]. 

[b]Public_testing 0.142.7 -> 0.142.8[/b]

A group of players have reported a problem with locating game save backup, resulting in an issue with loading the save file and starting a new game. Despite the fact that this bug happened to only a few players, it was so serious that we could not trivialize it and therefore we are now giving you version 0.142.8.

What we have fixed: 
[list]
[*] [b]Changed game save backup location[/b]
[*] Additionally fixed issues caused by assembling many rockets on a few workbenches simutanousely 
[/list]
We sincerely hope that this time major or serious bugs will not occur and there will be no more obstacles with the moving of this build to the default branch. 

We thank you immensely for your support and feedback. 

Yours,
OM team

notes.title: v0.142.7 available on public_testing!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Martians!
[/h1]

We greatly appreciate your efforts in testing version 0.142.4 available on the public_testing branch channel. As a result, we were able to make three major improvements:

[list]
[*] Lack of fuses in the Greenhouse - it’s no longer needed to take unused fuses from other rooms now. 
[*] Multiple canisters of the same seed type being deleted when one of them is used - should no longer occur.
[*] Auto-drive default button has been changed to C
[/list]
We also regret to inform you that [b]the automatic keyboard detection function of AZERTY had to be temporarily disabled[/b] due to unexpected problems. Our developers are working on refining this feature and hope to enable it again soon. We apologize to french-speaking players and thank you for your understanding.

[b]Feel free to try the newest build, v0.142.7 and let us know if any serious problems occur. [/b]

You can read the full changelog of the public_testing branch in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/3738610144944482116]previous devlog[/url]. Hopefully in a few days v0.142.7 will receive community's thumbs up and then we will switch it live on default branch. 😉

notes.title: Devlog #75: Patch v0.137.1d available for community on public_testing branch
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

Thank you for participating in the testing of version 0.137.1 on the public_testing branch. Thanks to your vigilance, we were able to make significant improvements to this build. Today, we are excited to release version 0.137.1d, which comes with several enhancements.

One of the issues you pointed out was the slow charging of vehicles, and we are pleased to inform you that we have addressed this problem, making the charging process much faster. Additionally, we have resolved the issue with loot tables, which was causing difficulties in long campaigns and resulting in a lack of seed magazines in abandoned bases.
We appreciate your help a lot! This is the way we want to work - in cooperation with our community, responding to your feedback.

We have deployed a [b]patch v0.137.1d on public_testing[/b] branch on Steam! It replaces previous version (0.137.1). Feel free to try it out. 
We will switch it to default branch if no major problems occur, 

Meanwhile we are working on the next one, which includes, among others, new graphic options and some performance upgrades.

[h3]Build v0.135.3 -> [b]v0.137.1d[/b] Changelog (public_testing)[/h3]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[b][*] fixed slow vehicle charging
[*] fixed problem with too big rover damage when hitting sand dunes and moving on rough terrain
[*] fixed loot tables randomization bug - no seed magazines (seed tanks) after long game[/b]
[*] fixed multiple bugs related to vehicle battery system (battery system refactored)
[*] implemented final Kickstarter backer reward: 3D heads of "The Martian" backers
[*] fixed: heavy suit changes color after loading save
[*] fixed: opening capsule door sound distance
[*] fixed: cursor on the map is invisible
[*] fixed: cursor stays on tablet
[*] fixed: cursor triggered after leaving ESC menu
[*] fixed: missing key binding tips (introbase)
[*] fixed: too many batteries on tourist mode
[*] fixed: scrapped batteries and upgrades are grinded instantly
[*] fixed: can't assign the arrow keys
[*] fixed: can't print workbench using big crusher
[*] fixed: items from truck's inventory disappear
[*] fixed: stuck during sleeping
[*] fixed: game crashed after player tried to build refrigerator
[*] fixed: can't interact with broken ATV
[*] fixed: rover jumping on invisible collider
[*] fixed: some glitches on terrain
[*] fixed: black dust from nowhere
[*] fixed: price balance of printed bottles
[*] fixed: rover lights on start
[*] fixed: living capsule decorations bug
[*] fixed: wind turbines immune to meteors   
[*] fixed: case where players were getting stuck in composter screen
[*] fixed: can't detach container using T or rover button
[*] fixed: can't leave tech bench
[*] fixed: player not able to leave mechanics workbench after unlocking jackhammer III
[*] fixed: some outposts have one color textures
[*] fixed: the anti-meteorite system not working
[*] fixed: energy problem in base after patch
[*] fixed: very high power rate in hangar's charger
[*] fixed: mechanics tech tree exp exploit
[*] fixed: possibility to install battery extension in the Truck
[*] fixed: wrong LODs in escape sequence
[*] fixed: pump station doesn't give back resources after grinding
[*] fixed: problem with placing medium solar on the ground
[*] fixed: no possibility to pick up A3 ore
[*] fixed: bug related to MRE (processed food)
[*] fixed: building ATV doesn't detect circuit board
[*] fixed: after loading 1st autosave from introbase player close to death (sometimes outside the base)
[*] added extra references into game controller to reduce possibility of crashes

notes.title: Devlog #72: What's next
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

Thank you for playing the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3678931743363828117]Exploration Update[/url][/b] and for all the feedback! We really appreciate your guidance and suggestions which help us further develop this Early Access. With the recent Major Update we've fulfilled many of the Kickstarter's stretch goals and we've prepared the game core to allow easier updates in the future. 

[h3]Kickstarter goals fulfilled so far[/h3]
[list]
[*] ✅ Early Access Launched
[*] ✅ Technology Expansion
[*] ✅ Added Wind Turbines
[*] ✅ Added Heavy Suit
[*] ✅ Added Motocross
[*] ✅ Added Mars Truck
[*] ✅ Additional semi trailers
[*] ✅ Workshop battery charger, fusebox & sink
[/list]
We hear your feedback that perhaps the additional vehicles were not the most important to add at this time, but they were already almost done and we didn't want to delay our obligation to the backers. Also it's worth noting that they are optional. Unlocking Motocross or Truck is not mandatory to progress in the tech tree (for those who prefer to keep driving the Heavy Rover).

In this devlog we will write more about our current focus as well as our plans for next updates.

[h3]1. Balance and Quality of Life Improvements - in progress[/h3]

Based on your feedback sent via the F4 reporting system, eracolonisthelp e-mail, steam forums and discord threads we are prioritizing hotfixes for issues which affect current gameplay the most. We are going to release a series of patches and hotfixes to address the most commonly reported issues and suggestions.

[h3]2. Further Performance Optimization - in progress[/h3]

We know that there's still a lot to do in terms of performance optimization. Thanks to upgrading the engine, we now have better tools to track down bottlenecks in this regard. The main focus points for us right now in terms of optimization are:
[list]
[*] Optimizing terrain generation and outpost spawning while traveling
[*] Optimizing performance of big bases (saves with 150+ sols)
[/list]
It's too early to know if we can guarantee concrete results, but we are deeply analyzing possible solutions to this performance bottlenecks, and we will keep you updated as soon as we achieve some results.

[h3]3. Further Technical Upgrades - ongoing process[/h3]

As mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/3678931743363828116]previous devlog[/url], the following points are already being worked on:
[list]
[*] Additional Language versions
[*] Reworked animation system
[*] Improved graphics and lightning
[*] Online Co Op Multiplayer 
[/list]
[h3]4. Additional Content planned for the future[/h3]

After we solve the most important bottlenecks from points 1. and 2. we will return to content updates among which we have planned the big ones below:
[list]
[*] Construction (Vertical constructions, Grid buildings, Decoration system, Furniture)
[*] Robotics (Spotty robot companion, Drone Harvesters, Automated Extractors)
[*] Chemistry (Chemlab workbench, Substance crafting, Chemistry Techtree)
[*] Nuclear (Uranium refinement, Centrifuges, Kilopower reactors)
[/list]
It's too early to estimate exact dates of each of the updates mentioned above, however this is a reminder of our plan of continuous expansion of this game, according to our [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars]refreshed roadmap[/url].

Currently we are hard at work on next hotfixes and QoL changes. We have already released [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3665421577795527246]first patch v0.134.2[/url][/b] on Steam. The GOG and EPIC version requires an additional improvement and will be updated in a few days, together with the next patch.

[b]If you encounter any bugs or you have more thoughts about update, please email us to eracolonisthelp@gmail.com, this will help to track down the issues faster.[/b]

Also a reminder for all the new players who joined our community recently - below you will find useful links with FAQ, tips & tricks, wiki, roadmap and more information about the game's nuances:

[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/6274121610015372635/]Video Guide[/url] | [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/3828665107795840880/]Colonist FAQ[/url] | [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/1749021365362863747/]Troubleshooting FAQ[/url] | [url= https://occupymars.fandom.com/wiki/Occupy_Mars:_The_Game_Wiki]Wiki[/url] | [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars]Roadmap[/url] | [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/3130541756137068835/]TightBeam[/url] | [url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh]Discord[/url][/b]

Stay connected with us through our social channels to stay up-to-date with the latest news and share your thoughts. Thanks for being a part of this journey with us, and until next time!

Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Exploration Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

[b]Welcome to Sol #111 on Mars![/b] 

The Exploration Update is finally going live today, so let's dive in right into the details (this is going to be a long post). First check out the [b][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/427a8f49658b0f2ee9904685083b025d8e56ea23.png]info-graphic with summary[/url][/b] and our [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tlaCFJivRUw]brand new trailer[/url][/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/427a8f49658b0f2ee9904685083b025d8e56ea23.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=tlaCFJivRUw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Build v0.134.0 - Changelog[/h3]

[b]Core:[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded Unity Engine version to the most stable one
[*] Map generation system upgrade
[/list]
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] redesign of well panel (added more info and improved readability)
[*] added tanks for rover (for transporting water, oxygen and methane)
[*] added inventory boxes (for extra storage space)
[*] added possibility to hide from weather effects in abandoned bases
[*] added settings window during first game launching
[*] added snow dust when riding on frozen land
[*] added notification when player enters new location
[*] added tool durability system
[*] rebalanced amount of resources after grinding roadster
[*] added Motocross vehicle
[*] added Mars Truck vehicle
[*] added Wind Turbines (Big & Small)
[*] added Sink in the Workshop
[*] added possibility to switch on/off devices (fuses in buildings)
[*] added icons for every type of science bench
[*] added information in blueprints menu about how much energy does every object need
[*] added box for stacking circuit boards
[*] added battery rack for batteries and power expansions charging
[*] added the possibility to fix tools with repair kits and using workbench
[*] added the possibility to change suit in lobby building
[*] added the possibility to change suit colors in lobby building
[*] added Heavy Suit for astronaut
[*] added possibility to pick up ready to load rocks (player can throw them into crusher or truck’s trunk)
[*] added creating backup copy of player’s saves / save versioning
[*] reworked audio course system (affects performance)
[*] added more eye colors
[*] added possibility to change body type
[*] added the protection against the situation when player is stuck in screen because of weather event
[*] added the info about reaching max number of vehicles
[*] increased water flow in water spots
[*] added notifications in TPP view
[*] added possibility to print Solid Rocket A kit in Workshop Printer
[*] added possibility to find new batteries
[*] added several knowledge base records
[*] changed model of small crusher
[*] airlocks in abandoned bases remain open after the player unlocks them
[*] added arrows on crushers that indicate correct driving direction
[*] information about bonus to seeds quality on Seed Magazine
[*] added radiation and loot in destroyed base
[*] added option to change the mouse target color to a more contrasting one
[*] added possibility to destroy jetpack in the crusher
[*] added new look of electricity table
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed the problems with items disappearing from containers
[*] fixed Devil’s Dust weather effect killing player by sucking it out from the abandoned base
[*] problem with blocked door after driving rover
[*] problem with placing ATV ghost
[*] rare problem with inactive ESC button
[*] problem with blocking the game if driving on ATV into pile of cables
[*] problem with player dying in starting capsule because of wrong plant crate collider
[*] problem with player dying after walking into rover’s wheel on small crusher
[*] problem with player losing all of the plants and damaged buildings after saving during fire
[*] problem with player dying from suffocation after loading a save
[*] problem with water spot and well incorrect production values
[*] fixed some causes of transparent building (it won't fix old saves, but it shouldn't happen on the new ones)
[*] fixed taking water bottle with ctrl in tutorial 2
[*] fixed death from lack of oxygen after sitting in rover's chair
[*] raycast improvements (big bases optimization)
[*] fixed problem with incorrect weather effect when player is in abandoned base
[*] fixed invisible HQ collider
[*] fixed problem with inability to build new battery section after battery being damaged
[*] fixed most of the problems with loot falling under the terrain or into the foundations of the buildings
[*] fixed battery extension couldn't be repaired
[*] fixed wrong items for constructing workbench
[*] fixed chemistry tech tree points after use meteor rocket
[*] fixed most of the problems with players inside/outside status (causing transparent walls and “terraforming mars” bug)
[*] fixed LOD problems on higher graphic levels
[*] fixed tessellation active by default on lower graphic settings
[*] fixed problem with storage cabinet working as fridge
[*] fixed problem with tools doubling when upgrading one on workbench
[*] fixed problems with choosing tools on gamepad
[*] fixed missing key in infopanel (tutorial 6)
[*] changed sandstorm sound
[*] fixed resetting rover with trailer
[*] fixed quad floating after accident
[*] fixed ability to genetically engineer seeds without tech unlocked
[*] fixed container exploit

[*] fixed problem with meteor hit pushing player through the walls of the buildings

[*] several cases of player dying while running into rock and using jackhammer

[*] fixed broken helmet was nor marked red in the inventory

[*] fixed problem with LOD colors

[*] and much more...
[/list]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]

Our first plan is to introduce hotfixes to the exploration update based on your post-launch feedback. We also have some more tasks implemented which didn't make it to the testing phase but should arrive in the next updates. 

[b]Known issues[/b] we are currently working on fixing:
[list]
[*] the heavy suit doesn't work properly when you have realistic type movement enabled
[*] tech tree point number notification on HUD sometimes show incorrect number
[*] some save files need to be loaded from the main menu instead of esc menu
[*] after loading an autosave upon completing tutorial 2, you can die

[*] motocross can sometimes remain stuck on the track after transporting
[*] tablet UI improvements

notes.title: Devlog #71: New Vehicles in Exploration Update
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

A significant update is rapidly approaching. In the upcoming devlogs, we will be introducing to you what new things you will encounter on the surface of Mars. We will begin with new vehicles: a motocross bike and a pickup truck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/785ad2d6d4840afb96f5396ce34b3ecc353b9c84.png[/img]
The motocross bike is an electric motorcycle that enables fast movement across the planet. Riding it requires advanced skills, but experienced Martians will undoubtedly appreciate the joy of riding it. To construct it, a blueprint and building materials will be necessary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/7789eb202aa1057f8361aa17e8ef985c697667ed.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/32e0c13996c59d1e7535d0e2035391c824739538.png[/img]
The truck is an extremely versatile vehicle. Depending on your needs, you can transport ATVs or motocross bikes, and you can also manually load rocks onto the truck that can be dumped on the crusher. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/93ec3314f6faec005e447961a979edcc0b419cb9.png[/img]
Additionally, it provides protection from the cold at night, has 5 slots in the cargo inventory, and solar panels on the roof to recharge its battery. The front cargo area accommodates space for an electronic board controller, inventory control screen, and a place for an extension battery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/43b2e9f990a50b648b9d41bae4188c42dec00fcc.png[/img]
We will show you more upcoming features in the next devlog. Remember that there are only 2,5 weeks left until Exploration Update goes live!

[b]See you on the developer stream![/b] We meet as always: on Thursday at 17:00 CEST time [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pyramid_games]on Twitch[/url].

Occupy Mars Team

---------------------

P.S. Our Friends from Atomic Jelly Studio are releasing their [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/429380/Space_Mechanic_Simulator/]Space Mechanic Simulator[/url][/b] tomorrow:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/429380/Space_Mechanic_Simulator/

[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34127/]Rover Mechanic + Space Mechanic Bundle[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #69 Summer Sale & Progress Update
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Martians![/h2]

[b]Welcome to the Sol #60 since our landing on Mars![/b]

In this devlog #69 we will tell you more about the upcoming Major Content Update and what we've been focused on in the last few weeks, but first...

[h3]Welcome new players![/h3]

For those of you who have just recently joined us on our adventure: [b]please remember that Occupy Mars is a huge and complex open-world sandbox survival game for fans of the genre. The game may be hard to understand at first, but to make your start a little easier please check the following links[/b]: [list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQOps1WWd4PYWP1B4n6QFMxTPeUs-Th3d](Video Guide) How NOT to die on Mars — YouTube Playlist[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/3130541756137068835/](Video) TightBeam From Mars — our "making of" YouTube miniseries[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/3828665107795840880/][FAQ] Colonist FAQ: How to Survive on Mars[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/1749021365362863747/][FAQ] Game Troubleshooting FAQ: Frequently Asked Questions[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/2447091420207592791/][FAQ] CO2 scrubber tips by Cerber[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/6274121610017294365/][FAQ] How to Start by Tzemaru[/url]
[*] [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars]Occupy Mars: The Game — Roadmap[/url]
[*] [url= https://occupymars.fandom.com/wiki/Occupy_Mars:_The_Game_Wiki]Occupy Mars — Wiki[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh]Official Discord Server[/url]
[/list] In case of any issues please remember that you can always press F4 while playing the game to automatically send feedback (including screenshots and logs) directly from the game.

[h3]What we've been up to[/h3]

[b]1. Engine upgrade[/b]

Since the last update v0.122.2 we have started a huge rework of the game (in preparation for the Major Content Update) including [b]raising the Unity Engine version[/b]. We had to do this since the previously used version had a [b]texture limit[/b] and we couldn't add any more objects to the game. Together with the engine version bump [b]you should notice performance improvements[/b] and some graphics quality improvements.

[b]2. Save system rework[/b]

Once the game was successfully adapted to the new engine build our next focus was a [b]rework of the save system[/b], which seemed to cause the most issues reported by players. We found that the problem was related to [b]system language & culture settings[/b], that's why it only occurred for some players and was so hard to track down. But it should be finally solved!

[b]3. Content & Features[/b]

Next we focused on adding [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game][b]the content planned in our Kickstarter Roadmap[/b][/url] including but not limited to: [b]New Vehicles, Heavy Suit, Wind Turbines and much much more[/b]. Below you will find some sneak peaks of those features. We will write more details about them in the next devlog. You can also [url=https://youtu.be/7McP1Cur1c8?t=342]re-watch our yesterday's stream[/url] to get a closer look at some of the things we are preparing for you :)

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/579b9d93d8a76edc62fe49800c5ae7727c38494a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/7932ec85873e7e5121652749adad008f9210e925.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/41469ba4289d828a16aa95a6ec122a08b7cc49d9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/2541fc5b9e175d8aa117dec8a29d261189b3f1ee.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/d9867911295334e031a5a9f6146f21a79c63ad27.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/85f04c33968d23a0d6a9461612348f94102889e5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/b345d3844ac237ec1bc556110860b9d2a861087d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/39299f9ae762c518d8a9176ffef8ecadb66fd8e5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/fd873172c006868086f6496249d414071807f439.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/c75149d0d24822eecb5c065d2589ca35f1324736.png[/img][/url]

Our plan was to release this update for the Summer Sale (so between June and July), but making smaller updates without upgrading the engine was no longer possible. Ironing out the issues related to upgrading the engine took way longer than we initially expected, that's why we didn't make it on time with the major update release. We still need more time for testing and improving the new gameplay so our current schedule for the release of the big update is August. 

We want to ensure that this time, a much larger number of players will be pleased with the improved quality of the game after the update. Therefore, we believe that dedicating additional time to fine-tuning it will be worth it.

and while we all wait for the update...

[h3]New Bundle with Astro Colony[/h3]

We have just launched a fresh [b]bundle[/b] together with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1614550/Astro_Colony/][b]Astro Colony[/b][/url]. It's a cool space game made by our friends. The bundle together with the fact that Summer Sale is still running makes it a great value for the price!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32436/Occupy_Mars__Astro_Colony_Bundle/

[h3]Summer Sale[/h3]

The Summer Sale will last until Thursday July 13th so there are only a few days left to get Occupy Mars and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/pyramidgames]other games from our studio[/url] with the biggest discounts of the year!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/pyramidgames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/8704d5f8dabf8b92e284541ebe9bb9e7d95683c7.png[/img][/url]

[b]Wishing you a fantastic weekend in Space![/b]

[b]Warm regards,
The Occupy Mars Team[/b]

notes.title: Update v0.122.2 is Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Martians![/h2]

Welcome to the sixth week on Mars!

We are thrilled to announce that the testing phase for build v0.122.2 is now complete, and it has just been switched to the [b]default branch[/b]. Rest assured, if you encounter any issues, you can always revert to the [b]previous[/b] branch on Steam.

[h3]You can find the complete changelog for build v0.122.2 in the previous devlog:[/h3]
Check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/3687931332330630923?l=english

[b]In this update, we have introduced several exciting additions:[/b]

Autowalk feature
Suit charging from batteries and transformers
Building trailers and containers without the need for Big Crusher
And that's not all! This update also includes numerous other features and fixes.

We are currently reworking the save system, and while a major fix will be available in the next update, we have already resolved some of the issues with saving and loading the game.

[h3]We hope you thoroughly enjoy this update! But hold on tight, as we are already in the testing phase for the next one.[/h3]

In the upcoming weeks, we will provide you with more detailed information about our plans, as we have an exciting major update scheduled for June/July. Stay tuned for further updates! ːsteamhappyː

Don't forget that you can always press F4 to automatically send us feedback, including screenshots and logs directly from the game. 

For collecting priority bugs, we have a pinned forum thread available:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/0/3829792817308237223/ 

[b]Wishing you a fantastic weekend on Mars![/b]

[b]Warm regards,
The Occupy Mars Team[/b]

------------------------

notes.title: Update v0.122.2
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

[h3]Update v0.122.2 is now live on public_testing branch.[/h3]

This is a bigger patch than all the previous ones so we want to make sure there are no issues before putting it on the main branch. Those who wish to try it can [b]switch to public_testing branch on Steam[/b] but remember to backup your save files just in case. You can switch the branch in game's properties:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/b09ad5ae98b365cf5d36fc39cde8a2aa366a46e8.png[/img]
As a reminder: the save files to backup are located in the following directory:
[code]C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\LocalLow\PyramidGames\OccupyMars[/code]
Another important information is that due to adding Autowalk feature we had to reset controls settings to default so you may need to re-bind your keys again, sorry for the inconvenience. 

[h2]Changelog v0.122.2[/h2]

[b]Added Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] added Autowalk button
[*] camera now remembers selected FPP/TPP mode when player sleeps, sits and takes off helmet

[/list]
[b]Important bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed several saving issues
[*] fixed several loading issues
[*] fixed the problem with lack of possibility to refill empty bottles
[*] fixed the problem with game freezing when entering rover seat

[*] fixed the issue with crash caused by cables connected to ATV socket
[*] fixed issue with sound level of music and dialogues
[*] fixed the problem with blocker in Tutorial 6
[*] fixed the issue with duplicating boards

[*] fixed the issue with wrong electricity values in workshop caused by seed machine building and grinding

[*] fixed rover controller issue (game freezing after entering Rover seat)

[*] fixed the problem with inability to unlock technology despite having blueprint unlocked
[*] fixed the issue that blocked saving the game after completing all tutorials in intro base
[*] fixed several problems with objects placement in canteen and lobby
[*] fixed ITS crash site and error while using elevator
[*] fixed the issue that player’s base after load was out of power and sleeping after that crashed the game
[*] fixed problem with player gets stuck in chair when pressing ESC after ending tutorial
[/list]
[b]Minor issues fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed wrong number of parts in several items in printer menu
[*] fixed looped elevator sound while using the tablet
[*] fixed wrong text in popup after using tech point
[*] fixed disabled stand by sprite on tutorial monitor after load.
[*] fixed marker in the wrong place during the quest with build workshop
[*] fixed wrong objects in Tutorial 5
[*] fixed the problem that fuses can be removed through the closed flap in Tutorial 6
[*] fixed volume of AI Information sound and equalizing pressure adjustment sound
[*] fixed issue with HQ and Corridors giving items after being blown up
[*] fixed several wrong or missing translations in russian translation
[*] fixed the problem with player being unable to press tab during Tutorial 3
[*] fixed blur postprocess on players personal tablet screen
[*] fixed problems with closing tabs on the tablet
[*] fixed issue that allowed exploiting wall panels
[*] fixed buttons being highlighted and tutorial marker being visible aftert skipping intro
[*] fixed the problem with rover that can built it only in selected defined places

[*] fixed missing quest texts, missing other translations and wrong texts in french translation
[*] fixed problem with battery upgrade technology wrong key in polish translation

[/list]

We will monitor the forums during the weekend to make sure there are no important issues with this build and if everything is ok we will put it on the main branch on monday / tuesday.

As mentioned in the previous devlog: [b]we are planning a major content update for June/July[/b]. Stay tuned for more information! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 4th Patch!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

It's the 4th day after our [b]Early Access[/b] release - and we have another Patch for you!

Yesterday we have released info about postponing update 4, but today, after additional tests and help from community members, we decided to release this update on [b]public_testing[/b] branch, available for everyone who wants to check if the update fixes their problems. 

Please remember, that we are really small team and we are extremely tired after many hours of testing and preparing updates since Wednesday, so we are just afraid we might have missed something. So just in case please make backup of your OM saves folder to another location before trying the test branch so that you can restore them if anything goes wrong. [b]Your save files are located in:[/b] 

[code]C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\LocalLow\PyramidGames\OccupyMars[/code]
To test the patch open the game properties on Steam, go to Beta tab, and select the [b]public_testing[/b] branch. If everything goes well with this patch we'll put it on the default Steam branch as well, after some time. If anything goes wrong you can switch back to default build in the same place (Properties/Beta) tab.

[b]Build v0.119.5[/b] - Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fix for restoring default settings changed movement type from instant to realistic
[*] Fix for Rover collision detection in Hangar
[*] Automatic door opening in launchpad elevator
[*] Fix for bug preventing jumping if going on elevator right after talking with NPC
[*] Additional optimization of Intro Base NPC animations
[*] Fix for building Storage Cabinets (Refrigerators) in workshop
[*] Added button to skip escape from Destroyed base after 3 deaths
[*] Fixed possibility to block HUD tutorial monitor after jumping
[*] Fixed occlusion view from the top of ITS
[*] Fixed deathloop after fall in escape sequence 
[*] Fixed Space Forest achievement unlocked after completing tutorials
[*] Fixed incomplete date in arabic save files
[/list]
Please let us know about the issues you are experiencing to help us prioritize the next patches.

Hopefully tomorrow we will have another patch with next set of fixes.

Remember you can always press F4 to automatically send us feedback with screenshot and log directly from the game.

notes.title: Occupy Mars Today!
notes.content:
[h2]Martians! The day has come![/h2]

[b]Occupy Mars: The Game is now available for all of you to play in Early Access! See the Launch Trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=0BgyGklgsas;full][/previewyoutube]
It's truly indescribable how amazing it feels to finally reach this day of launch after years of hard work! This incredible journey began more than 10 years ago when we conceived the idea for this game during our time at university. 

The development of the game itself started in 2017, and now we have reached the significant milestone of Early Access Launch. Our dream game has reached a point where we are thrilled to share it with you! 

This is just the beginning of a much longer journey, as we have an [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars]ambitious roadmap[/url] ahead of us.

[h3]But for now, let's focus on playing![/h3]

For those diving right into the game - please keep in mind that the following [b]known issues in the current build v0.119.1:[/b] 
 - loading abandoned bases - procedural outposts can sometimes relocate after loading the game
 - saving the game when rover is on crusher can in some cases block rover
 - ATV sometimes doesn't spawn next to the abandoned base but further away
 - tornado/dust devils can pull the player from abandoned base and throw them away with high speed
 - repairing boards one after another can block workbench
 - soldering tool and hot-air tool can disappear from workbench
 - player can die when building rover and standing too close to the ghost
 - cables can hang in the air and block interactions
 - tutorial 6 can be blocked if player replants tree seedlings to crate before receiving instruction to do so
 - there may be gaps in the terrain at the borders of the map squares
 - There may be FPS drops while riding ATV/ROVER
 - loot may spawn under the terrain or inside walls/floors
 - player can be able to equip 2 tools at once and block interactions
 - weather effects may last after the icon on hud disappears
 - ATV crates content is not saved
 - saving game manually when there is space sign at the end of save's name blocks saving the game
 - after longer gameplay random textures may be spawn on random models or not spawn at all 

[b]Minor or less frequent issues and edge cases:[/b]
 - the surface of frozen lake can spawn over the ground
 - there are several rare issues which can randomly block saving the game
 - ghost of rover can be built only in specific places
 - saving the game after placing ghost of workbench but before building it may be impossible
 - leaving the base while printer works freezes printer indefinitely.
 - aiming while using jackhammer&grinder can be sometimes difficult
 - upgrading jackhammer to level 3 without unlocked technology is possible but can break the game
 - player can duplicate boards on workbench but doing so can block facility.
 - boards may have full HP while having broken parts on workbench
 - saving and loading the game after upgrading tool but before taking it from workbench duplicates the tool but can break the game
 - FPP camera while driving on ATV can go inside players head on some angles
 - charging suit from battery/transformer may sometimes not work
 - tipper dislodged from trailer by meteor can be impossible to reattach
 - after loading save from campaign, there are pipes and cables in ambulatory 
 - some sounds may not be properly adjusted
 - the list of backers in credits is bigger than text field can handle so it's cut - will be fixed in an update


This is a big game and those issues are generally rare, we just wanted to make sure you know.

We are focusing on solving all of those issues as well as adding more content.

We are planning regular updates. Next one will be live tomorrow, and the next the day after tomorrow ːsteamhappyː

Remember that you can press F4 during the game to post Feedback directly to us. 

[b]See you on Mars![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/fdcf46409c7d26ef8ef680ce7d2b3067296ea365.png[/img]

notes.title: DevLog #61: Release Time Map & SteelSeries integration
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Martians![/h2]

[b]We have some exciting news! [/b]

We have joined forces with [b]SteelSeries[/b] to bring your game experience to a whole new level! 
Thanks to [b]GameSense[/b] integration you can immerse yourself with precise rover controls, alerts and lights which will keep you informed about the state of your water, oxygen and other parameters!

[h3]See what SteelSeries has in store for you![/h3]

[previewyoutube=2ce02UbdLXA;full][/previewyoutube]

There are only [b]4 days left[/b] until the Early Access release!

The best way to stay up to date with the launch time is to observe the timer on the game’s official page: [b][url=https://occupymarsgame.com]occupymarsgame.com[/url][/b]

That said, we understand that in the heat of preparation for your Mars adventure one might not be able to keep track of time. 😉

That’s why we've prepared this graphic for you, which lists the launch time as it should appear in various corners of the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/2b79926f8d8d879af9a77cff107de3e6d3889889.png[/img]

[b]Remember about differences in time zones![/b] In our time (CEST), release time is 6 PM, but this may not necessarily be the case for you.

[h3]Take note of your local release time and see you on Mars on May 10th![/h3]

Kind Regards,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: DevLog #59: Content at Launch
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

[b]We’re getting ready for May 10th and we’d like to share a few more details with you.[/b]

[b]All our Kickstarter Backers who supported the project and who had Early Access key listed as one of the rewards for their pledge will be happy to know that we’re currently sending out keys! Please check your e-mail inboxes! Keep in mind that even though you receive them a little ahead of release time, keys will become active at the moment of Early Access release on May 10th. 

You can follow the countdown clock on our official website: [url=https://occupymarsgame.com]occupymarsgame.com[/url][/b]

We’d like to thank our 12,000 Beta testers for their contribution to the Beta Playtest phase. Thanks to you, we’ve received plenty of invaluable feedback and managed to greatly improve overall game experience. Beta Playtest version will be available until May 8th so this is the [b]last weekend to play it[/b]. 
On Monday this particular version will be disabled in preparation for Early Access launch.

We have also determined a [b]final list of features which will be available on Early Access release[/b], and other functionalities which will be subsequently enabled in the next updates according to our [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars][b]updated roadmap[/b][/url].

[h2]The features which will be available on launch day include:[/h2]

[h3]Language versions available on launch: 10[/h3]

[b]English, Polish, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Turkish, Russian, Portugese, Chinese.[/b]
[i](we are also working on Ukrainian, Romanian, Dutch, Japanese and Korean but those are not ready and will be added in an update later)[/i]

[h3]Game modes available on launch: 3[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Campaign [/b]Mode (introduction to the story with NPCs and cinematics!)
[*] [b]FreePlay [/b]Sandbox Mode (procedurally generated gameplay where you can select difficulty level, starting location, starting equipment, intensity of weather conditions and other parameters)
[*] [b]Tutorial Mode[/b]: E.R.A. Virtual Training: 6 Tutorial scenes
[*] and of course [b]detailed character creator[/b]!
[/list][i](the continuation of the Campaign mode, more tutorial scenes, as well as an Online Co-Op mode will come to the game later in the form of updates)[/i]

[h3]Technology Trees available on launch: 4[/h3]
[b]Botany, Electricity, Materials, Mechanics[/b]
[i](the Chemistry tech tree will be added later as an update, also some technologies in each tech tree are locked and will be added after early access launch)[/i]

[h3]Vehicles available to build in the game at early access launch:[/h3]
[b]ATV Quad (with upgrades), Ingenuity Helicopter, Jetpack and Heavy Rover with 2 types of trailers[/b].
[i](Motocross and Truck still require some driving adjustments so they will be enabled later)[/i]

[h3]Available tools:[/h3]
[b]Air Compressor, Blowtorch, Grinder, Jackhammer, Seed Tool, Spectral Detector, Cordless Drill, Detonator, Fire extinguisher, Remote controller, pipes, cables and various building materials.[/b]

[h3]Plants available to cultivate:[/h3]
[b]Apple, Oxygen Tree, Poplar, Spruce, Pepper, Corn, Tomato, Potato, Lettuce, Cabbage, Pumpkin.[/b]

[h3]Weather events:[/h3]
[b]Sandstorms, Dust devils, Tornado, Solar storm, Meteor shower, Lightning Strike, Cold nights.[/b]

[h3]Tablet Functions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Messages[/b] - new version of the quest log 
[*] [b]Inventory[/b] - completely new inventory view
[*] [b]Blueprints[/b] - list of constructions to build
[*] [b]Tech Trees[/b] - technology browser and unlocking section
[*] [b]Knowledge Base[/b] - a goldmine of knowledge about Mars
[*] [b]Radar[/b] - useful for mapping surroundings and remotely controlling devices
[/list]additional tablet views include:[list]
[*] [b]Alarm clock view[/b] - shown after clicking on a bed
[*] [b]Bluetooth Radio control[/b] - shown after clicking on a Radio (allows to play your own music)
[*] [b]Robots[/b] view - currently disabled as player can't yet own robots 
[/list]
[h3]Buildings available to build at early access launch:[/h3]
Airlock, ramp, 2x leveling corridor joints, small solar panel, medium solar panel, transformer, transformer upgrade, battery, battery upgrade, lamp, 3x antennas, well, co2 scrubber, sabatier reactor, vertical tanks, horizontal tanks, pump, small rock crusher, big rock crusher / printer, greenhouse with hydroponics shelf, plant incubator, seed machine, composter, small dome, medium dome, large dome, workshop, living capsule, survival capsule, bathroom, various capsule adapters, lobby, cantina, main hab (HQ) with equipment, food processing unit, small 3d printer, bed, fridge, workbench, 4x science bench types for different technologies, the garage (hangar), anti-meteor launcher, 9 types of corridors (long, short, with or without windows, 90 deg angle and crossroads).

[i](more objects, buildings and vehicles will be enabled in subsequent updates)[/i]

[b]Certain technologies in the game will be marked as “Beta” on launch[/b] – these features are a work in progress and as such, they will still be updated and changed. Some functionalities are disabled and as a result, [b]certain achievements will be disabled at launch[/b] – the ones which will be disabled are listed below:
[list]
[*] Life on Mars
[*] Good Martian
[*] You've got a friend in me
[*] Rocket Scientist
[*] The cake is a lie
[*] Let's Cook
[/list] [i]those will start working after more technologies will be unlocked in content updates.[/i]

We’d like to let you know right away that [b]you’re welcome to report any issues[/b] you encounter in Early Access. For this purpose, in-game reporting feature (triggered by [b]F4[/b] key) has been fixed and added to the Early Access version.

[b]P.S. What’s the first thing you’ll do after arriving on Mars?[/b] 
Watch the E.R.A. Corporate news below for some ideas 🚀
[previewyoutube=qc6XOF1tQxM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]We are excited to see you on Mars!
Occupy Mars Team[/h3]

[b]P.S.2. May The 4th Be with you![/b]

notes.title: DevLog #56: Kickstarter Summary, Early Access Progress & Tight Beam from Mars
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians![/h1]

Welcome to another DevLog - this time we have plenty of topics to discuss.

[h2]1. Kickstarter Summary[/h2]

As you might know, our [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/]Kickstarter Campaign[/url][/b] ended on February 17th after 31 days and [b]it was a great success![/b] [b]Over 2662 Martians[/b] backed our project and we crossed the magical [b]400% Funded[/b] mark.

In total [b]13 Stretch Goals[/b] were unlocked with the last one: [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3733716]Automated Excavation[/url][/b] being unlocked during the last few hours of the campaign!🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/e4e5c8b1b1123130dd91d70967be4aeecc10a872.png[/img]

In the last few Kickstarter Updates you can read about:
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3731194]The final list of all unlocked stretch goals[/url][/b] 
(which will also serve as [b]our roadmap for post-release development)[/b]
[*] [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3733716]Automated Excavation plan[/url][/b]
[*] [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3733714]Kickstarter Reward Highlights[/url][/b]
[*] [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts]and more...[/url]
[/list]
[h2]2. Kickstarter Rewards[/h2]

Now that Kickstarter had ended, we're [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3733714]preparing to send rewards[/url][/b] to our amazing backers. 
According to plan: [b]most of the digital rewards should be sent in March, and the Physical Collector's Edition Boxes should be ready to send in May[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/371496f00c500d5fa88588bc06188696ed1f565f.png[/img]

[h2]3. Early Access Build Progress[/h2]

We are [b]working hard on the final Early Access Build[/b]. There's still a few things to do in order to give you the news you're all waiting for – about Early Access release date. 

[h3]Currently [b]our internal goal is to release Early Access by the end of March or April[/b]. The final date depends on final testing and balancing the game. [b]We'll make the announcement as soon as we're ready.[/b][/h3]

[h2]4. Freeplay Rebalance & Vehicle Building[/h2]

In the last devlog we've shown the progress with [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/3633877993333406386]New Inventory, Tutorials and Interior Lighting[/url][/b]. 

Today we want to show you the progress regarding [b]Freeplay rebalance and Vehicle Spawning, as well as progress with the Tech Tree.[/b]

[b]The Tech Tree[/b] in the game has been expanded. With many more technologies and blueprints to unlock. Those changes are connected with the game rebalance and with the way vehicles are spawned.

At the beginning of the Freeplay (Sandbox) mode player will start without vehicles. At first our Martian will have to survive based on the resources available in the landing capsule. First few nights will require sleeping in the capsule as well. But soon after, by unlocking new technologies and blueprints, he will be able to travel further and further away from the starting location, mine more resources, build buildings, new equipment and eventually also [b]build vehicles[/b]. 

We believe this rework will give a much greater sense of progression and satisfaction from gameplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/3d1f7c3492995d8812db2457f41a6db01240c676.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/ac79c3dac6c8a438442a41bddf91f387ed87b234.png[/img]

[h2]5. Tight Beam From Mars: Episode 9 - Growing Plants[/h2]

For those who might have missed it - we have released another Episode of [b]Tight Beam from Mars[/b]. In [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-j-xu5ehMwI]Episode #9[/url][/b] we are focusing on [b]Plant Cultivation[/b] where we explain the details about how it works in our game vs real simulated Mars bases. Watch the new [b]Episode 9[/b] below:

[previewyoutube=-j-xu5ehMwI;full][/previewyoutube]
If you haven't seen the previous episodes yet, [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQOps1WWd4PYMXAgMfK8ZnsycFEyanLXv]here's the full playlist[/url][/b].

In the next Episode #10 we will talk about [b]Energy Production and Survival Events[/b].

[h2]6. Occupy Mars: Colony Builder - Mobile tests started[/h2]

We have [b]started the tests of our mobile game[/b] [b][url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pyramidgames.occupymarscolonybuilder]Occupy Mars: Colony Builder[/url][/b]. 

[b]Over 300 backers[/b] are already playing the [b]Android & iOS Beta version[/b], reporting bugs and helping us balance it before the release. We have also released a [b]new teaser trailer of Occupy Mars: Colony Builder[/b] - you can watch it below:

[previewyoutube=a572vUepJYA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]7. Thank you![/h2]

Once again, [b]we'd like to thank each and every one of you[/b] – our backers and everyone here on Steam who believes in us. It's thanks to you that this project has come this far and we have no words to describe how thankful we are for your support throughout all these years.

We're working hard to bring you a truly memorable experience.

Yours Truly Grateful,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: DevLog #55: Early Access Development Progress
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

Today we'd like to tell you a little bit more about development progress for the Early Access build.

[h3]New Interior lightning[/h3]

Some of you may have already noticed in our Kickstarter trailer that we've introduced improved interior lighting to the game. We haven't had a chance to mention it yet, but this change has made the game both more visually appealing and faster in terms of performance, as the previous lighting was quite demanding on the GPU. You can see some screenshots with the new lighting below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/734c4cab9a5d82a5c480dc8b3883bf8622be8219.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Inventory[/h3]

In addition, we have revamped the player's inventory, equipment, and consumption systems to make them more integrated and user-friendly. Putting on and taking off the helmet will now be a breeze - simply drag and drop the helmet into the appropriate slot. The same change applies to water and oxygen bottles. In the early access build, players will be able to 3D print empty bottles and refill them with substances as needed. On Mars, every item will be valuable, so after use, the bottle will be refillable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/1386cabb1ce9e7b0cbd059e14e431115b2c49ac7.png[/img]

[h3]New Tutorials[/h3]

The new tutorials in the game are not only redesigned to provide better introduction to the story, now they are also organized as a in-game virtual simulation which you will be able to revisit using different screens in the campaign mode. We've also added a special HUD tutorial where our Suit AI will guide you through the most important functions of your suit, helmet and visor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/77b3be3ef4369769cddcda55074aa555d6217d5e.png[/img]

[h3]European Rover Challenge 2023[/h3]

Just like during previous years, this year we will join forces with [url=https://roverchallenge.eu/]European Rover Challenge[/url] once again for #ERC2023! The space & robotics event will take place on 15–17 September 2023 in Kielce, Poland and like every year, the highlight of the event will be #Rovers Robotics Competition! 

[url=https://roverchallenge.eu/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/483f93f4cbe6a1c43853b713f7afed41ef35c8bb.png[/img][/url]

The European Rover Challenge is an international space & robotics event combining competition of Martian rovers with scientific and technological shows. The main part of the project is an international robotics competition, where academic teams from around the world present their mobile robot designs, competing in competitions based on real ESA and NASA missions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/206aa98cc98b19db4cfc894c5cde04052fdf2fcd.jpg[/img]

The competition takes place on the world’s largest artificial Martian track, that is directly derived from the surface of the Red Planet.

In 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022 we partnered with the European Rover Challenge organized annually by the European Space Foundation. During the event, we organized an e-tournament of “Rover Mechanic Challenge” – a special version of our game “Rover Mechanic Simulator.” 

In the previous edition of the ERC, we provided competition winners with additional rewards such as “Astronaut survival toolkits” and this year we will support them again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/12aa45239aa827374b83c5e7924cda4557b9d18d.jpg[/img]

See you on Mars!
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: DevLog #53: Beta status & 10th Kickstarter goal unlocked
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

[h3]Beta Status Update[/h3]

As the recent build [b]v0.99.9.3[/b] was met with positive reception and our playtesters have noted a vast improvement over the previous build, we’re moving this build from the public_testing branch to the default branch on Steam.

[h3]To whoever has yet to update the Beta to the latest version, we recommend starting a new game as saves from the previous versions might not work properly after the update.[/h3]

We thank all of you who participated in Beta for all the feedback and bug reports we have received from you so far. [b]Occupy Mars: The Game[/b] has come a long way since we first started Beta and it’s all thanks to you. We now have a much better understanding regarding what requires our attention. That’s why we’d like to let you know that [b]this update is the final update for Beta[/b]. Any more days spent on improving the Beta would delay the long awaited Early Access. That’s why we think it’s about time to move on to the next stage. From here onwards, we’re focusing solely on preparing a final Early Access build.

[b]Known Issues in Beta  v0.99.9.3:[/b] 
[list]
[*] rover door can be opened partially and blocked in that position if player instantly after clicking on the door uses hotbar to pull out any tool. That can be reversed by doing the same thing,
[*] when player puts partially crushed rock in the tipper, sometimes it doesn’t crumble. In that case try to grab it and put it again in different spot in tipper,
[*] sometimes player can see "holes" in the map in places when two parts of the map are connected. Saving and reloading fixes problem,
[*] some weather effects can affect the player even if he is inside a base,
[*] abandoned bases may disappear and appear after loading the game,
[*] there might still be problems with rover extensions and/or skill points in tech tree,
[*] in some PC configurations players can experience significant drop of FPS in FPP mode,
[*] inability to skip sleeping in some rare cases,
[*] seed machine can sometimes duplicate seed tanks,
[*] some parts of abandoned bases don't disappear when the base is scrapped.
[/list]
[b]Important notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] there are several smaller but non game breaking bugs in the tutorials, there will be different tutorials in the full Early Access build so please don't report bugs regarding those,
[*] there are several non critical bugs that do not break the game but may cause inconvenience for the players, both of those categories will be fixed for EA,
[*] if you are playing on save from previous version building connectors will need to be removed and replaced due to the fix to stop you going outside through them,
[*] as we introduce new tutorials and campaign mode we have to shift focus from the beta version to prepare the build for Early Access.
[/list]

[h3]Kickstarter Progress[/h3]

[b]We did it![/b] We just crossed the 80 000 CA$ stretch goal, which means that “[b]Dexter[/b]'' goal has been unlocked! A crafting mechanic will be added to the game, which will allow you to [b]create chemical compounds[/b]!

It’s the [b]10th goal[/b] of this campaign and we’re only now halfway into the campaign. In 2 weeks, we’re already [b]265% funded[/b] and we have [b]17 days left[/b]! 

Just look how far we’ve come! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/223b08d6b13beb4c5525af74ed8c6cd8e89ee677.png[/img]

Next stop – “Liftoff!”, which will unlock once we gather another 10 000 CA$. Can we do it?

Big thank you to over [b]1 680 Martians[/b] who have supported the project so far! There are still plenty of goals waiting for us, so let’s keep going!

Best Regards,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Devlog #50: Beta Update & Kickstarter Status
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Martians![/h2]

Welcome to our [b]50th Monthly Devlog[/b]! We have just released the long-awaited [b]Beta Update v0.99.2[/b] which includes big changes such as: 

[h3]New Interaction System[/h3]

An important [b]rework of the interaction system[/b] has been completed and playtesters can now check it out. It was [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars][b]a very important milestone on our roadmap to Early Access[/b][/url], which should address one of the most frequently reported issues - to make the controls more responsive and more user friendly. 

[url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/80f79ba0dc63fa1473308621fab36ea6088ba272.png[/img][/url]

The most important thing you should know about the [b]New Interaction System[/b] is that now: 

* [b]pressing 1x LMB[/b] = picks up an item to your hand, and then: 
--- [b]the second time you press LMB[/b] = it will collect the item from your hand into your inventory 
--- [b]if you are holding any tool[/b] then of course the [b]LMB[/b] will intuitively use that tool
--- [b]press 2x LMB quickly[/b] (or hold [b]CTRL+LMB[/b]) to take the item from the ground directly to your inventory (no more hold and wait!)

* [b]pressing 1x RMB[/b] = stop using tool or drop other item from your hand on the ground
--- [b]you also need to press RMB[/b] to cancel any action such as sitting in the Vehicle or Workbench
--- keep in mind that the [b]ESC[/b] button will no longer work to cancel actions because we've introduced...

[h3]New Pause Menu[/h3]

After carefully analyzing your requests and after many discussions we decided to add the new [b]ESC Menu[/b].
- All the game settings, saves and control settings were moved from the Tablet to the new Pause Menu
- You can now press ESC at any time during the gameplay (except a few places) to open the Pause Menu which is separate from the Tablet functionality. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/920f9d5f1ca2f19cddc27bf959ec40b9980fb69f.png[/img]

[h3]New Main Menu Experience[/h3]

Today we also have [b]something special[/b] for you: the new main menu you know from our last weekly streams has been merged with the Beta branch so now you can admire it in its full glory. We've also uploaded a music video from it - a [b]4K artistic experience[/b] - you can watch it now on our YouTube channel:

[previewyoutube=uOsiigPeF1I;full][/previewyoutube]
If you love it like we do, you can listen it on repeat here ➡️ https://pls.watch/#v=uOsiigPeF1I 😉

[h3]Beta Update Changelog[/h3]
v0.93.3 -> v0.99.2

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Interaction System
[*] New Pause Menu
[*] New Main Menu Experience
[*] Added small 3D Printer in Landing Capsule
[*] Added small CO2 Scrubber in Landing Capsule
[*] Added text captions to voice notification system
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Pump UI values going out of frame
[*] Fixed infinite lightning storm sometimes happening
[*] Fixed starting capsule light, power and oxygen
[*] Fixed battery building collider limitations
[*] Fixed the wind power of dust devils
[*] Fixed water tank changing color after detonation
[*] Fixed resetting vehicles in hangar
[*] Fixed hand-holding position of multiple objects
[*] Fixed 3D printing UI and dropdowns
[*] Fixed vehicles getting explosion damage
[*] Fixed Rover driving slower when full
[*] Fixed overwriting autosave/quicksave 
[*] Fixed ores spawning in caves of Olympus Mons
[*] Fixed sleeping in landing capsule chairs
[*] Fixed meteor shower giving mechanics experience
[*] Fixed Air compressor Tool
[*] Fixed radiation Geiger sounds
[*] Fixed rocks loading on trailer during world shifting
[*] Fixed some player animations (jumping, crouching, interactions)
[*] Fixed postprocessing on screenshots of saved games
[*] Fixed saving loot items from destroyed bases
[*] Fixed saving player inside caves
[*] Fixed holding more than one item in hand
[*] Fixed dirt on Rover after sandstorm
[*] Fixed Rover trailer self detach
[*] Fixed damaging crusher after parking Rover on it
[*] Fixed Rover welder with/without container
[*] Fixed mouse acceleration setting save
[*] Fixed lightsource in HQ and other buildings
[*] Fixed saving game during repairing pcb board
[*] Fixed Well UI screen interaction
[*] Fixed battery capacity calculation after destroying battery upgrades
[*] Improved Heavy Rover wheels
[*] Improved DragBuilder interactions
[*] Improved interior lights in buildings
[*] Improved buildings Lobby, Cantina and others
[*] Improved graphics option (added TerrainPixelError)
[*] Improved player hands animations
[*] Improved text massage panel on the right
[*] Improved quality on lower graphics settings
[*] Improved small pickable rocks, more pickup types
[*] Optimization of GPU materials instancing on dynamic objects
[*] Balance Fix - Dust on solar panels disappeared too quickly
[*] Multiple translations improvements
[*] ...and more
[/list]
[b]Known Issues in this version:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Composter is not working[/b] in this build.
[*] Once you dump rocks from the trailer into the crusher you need to save & load, otherwise you [b]won't be able to load the trailer with rocks[/b] again.
[*] The New Interaction System should also work with [b]gamepad controllers[/b] however we didn't have time to properly test it yet, let us know if there are any problems.

[*] [quote][b]Warning! Do not play with headphones[/b] as there are a few sounds which are too loud playing during the loading of the game as well as during the game when new terrain chunks with abandoned bases are generated.[/quote]
[*] [quote][b]Warning![/b] Before playing please [b]reset your controls settings to default[/b] in main menu after updating to this version, otherwise new interactions may cause strange issues.[/quote]
[/list]The above mentioned known issues will hopefully be fixed in the next 0.99.x build. Please let us know if you find any more issues.

[h3]100th Development Sprint![/h3]

Our plan currently is that [b]builds up to version v0.99.x will be the last builds for the beta[/b], and [b]builds v0.100+ will go only to the main game Early Access branch[/b] so that we can focus on the main game release and make sure everything is polished there.

[b]Build v0.100 is a great milestone[/b] - it means that [b]we have completed over 100 2-week sprints[/b] while working on the game since the beginning. Looking back at those 5 years, it’s hard to imagine the amount of work we’ve put into it, we hope you will enjoy it. For the next build, we'll be focusing on the most important [b]Tech Tree[/b] and Balance changes necessary before Early Access Release.

[h3]Kickstarter Status[/h3]

As we promised in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3480747995742366775][b]Previous Update[/b][/url], we’d like to let you know about the status of the upcoming Kickstarter campaign as soon as anything clarifies. 

Just before Christmas we've learned that another Kickstarter campaign for a different game was started on the same partner account so we need to wait until it ends. We were surprised by this but, after talking to advisors experienced with Kickstarters they said it's a good thing because campaigns during Winter Holidays historically aren't as successful and that January is better time. So after talking it over, we’ve accepted this fact since this is better for the game as well.

So we can finally confirm that [b]our Kickstarter campaign will launch on January 17th[/b]. That also means that [b]Early Access release will come later than January 2023 (after the Kickstarter finishes)[/b]. As for our talks with potential international publishers (mentioned in the last devlog) they are still ongoing so we'll keep you posted once we have some more information about it.

We’ve also made a small update to [url=www.occupymarsgame.com][b]the game’s official page[/b][/url] - added a countdown for Kickstarter Launch:

[url=www.occupymarsgame.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/53080bb0e8bb884753d94745623555bc6e6c7189.png[/img][/url]

[h3]More beta invites[/h3]

Each new Beta build comes with new Beta invitations, so we're giving access to the Beta to more players. As we feel this update is particularly important, we’re now granting access to the Beta to additional [b]7 000[/b] randomly chosen players from those registered in the Steam Playtest system. With this, 10 000 players should now have access to the Beta version! That's a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/f0b62f41973056e732597d16eb7d1e20627b90ed.png[/img]

To all of you who find Occupy Mars: The Game Playtest version in their Steam library – we hope you'll enjoy the game and [b]please remember to give us your feedback[/b]!

[h3]Sharing your feedback[/h3]

A separate Sub-Forum on Steam called Beta Discussions was created for those who have access: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1802390/discussions/0/][b]LINK[/b][/url]
After playing please also remember to fill our Beta Survey:  [url=https://forms.gle/GhnUszERMjpDDrNy5][b]LINK[/b][/url]

We also have dedicated channel on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sv9UWeh][b]Discord server[/b][/url]! 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png[/img][/url]

Sorry we were unable to post this before Christmas but all this clarified on the last moment and also some of us got sick (Flu Season), but now we are back at work with full speed! :)

Best Regards,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Beta Update + Halloween comes to Occupy Mars BETA! 🎃
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Martians![/h2]

The spooky day of Halloween is here! We couldn’t pass by the opportunity to celebrate and this is why we’re bringing [b]Halloween pumpkins to Occupy Mars: The Game BETA version[/b]!

While we’re at it, we have also [b]invited more people to participate in playtests[/b]! If you’re one of players who signed up and didn’t have access to Beta, take a look at your email inbox! Perhaps one of the invitations made its way to you! 🙂

[b]Beta Playtest Changelog v0.93.3[/b]
- added Halloween Pumpkins!
- added "Universal Corridor Radiation Shield" 
- added power and oxygen calculations to LandingCapsule
- added bigger cargo room to ITS rocket
- added tablet shortcuts I, M, B...
- more intensive weather effects depending on difficulty level
- fixed resource detection in rocks
- fixed all rock types react to explosions
- fixed plants physics
- reworked character creator in main menu
- improved vehicle driving / handling / grip / controls
- improved rocks optimization 
- improved spectral detector
- improved save system
- improved player character & parameters
- improved parking space on small crusher
- improved ambandoned bases
- improved UI
- balanced Kilopower radiation
- [b]...and many, many, Many other bugs fixed thanks to our awesome Beta Testers![/b]

[h3]Pumpkins![/h3]

[b]As soon as you start the beta, you’ll receive some pumpkins in your starting capsule. [/b]

From there, you can:

[b]Pick them up[/b], throw them and otherwise spread all around Mars 🎃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/8a992018082d0ad2ccfa0070eaa66693eae5e790.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/07c689d166a37f94efdee9637435043a195ca411.png[/img]

[b]Add some Halloween atmosphere to your base[/b] – they can provide light! A very faint one, but it might at the very least help with navigating around the base in the dark. 😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/69480b407a16d3bec40cc91e44e725a14cac725e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/9cb8b22d4acfbb0e2bcefa9d485b911232c129fb.png[/img]

[b]Eat them[/b] – not the first thing you’d have in mind for a carved Halloween pumpkin, but it’s a good emergency option in case you run out of food on Mars. 😋

What you do with them is up to you – they’re just there to give you some fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/32f87915d76a3780cadfbf474aa6c94d627fdaf7.gif[/img]

[b]Have a great Halloween time![/b]

Occupy Mars Team
