notes.title: Devlog #20: Food processing unit
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fhtARef.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Dear Martians![/b][/h1]

Creating a prosperous colony on Mars and surviving there requires lots of energy. You will have to take good care of yourself and make sure you don’t forget to eat nutritious food, which will give you strength to succeed in this mission! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zB5ZyxV.gif[/img]

As you might know from previous devlogs, inside your greenhouse and main HQ, you will grow various crops in order to establish a reliable food source on Mars. When your crops are ripe, you will need to harvest them as soon as possible to prevent them from rotting. Your veggies and other agricultural products will be stored in the player’s inventory. They will all be ready for immediate consumption, but if you want to eat something more nutritious, you will have to prepare your food using a [b]food processing unit[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MqUEfSf.gif[/img]

The [b]food processing unit[/b] will allow you to transform various types of products into space food, which will give you lots of energy to bravely overcome any challenges and become a successful colonist. To make a meal, you can use one product or combine different products. You don’t have to follow specific recipes. When food processing is over, you can collect your meal from the [b]machine’s tray[/b] and it will be automatically placed in your inventory.

-----

Stay tuned for more updates and keep following us on social media! If you have any questions or just want to know more about the game, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/nscTUpu]discord channel[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #16: ChemLab
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q27OcYI.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Dear Martians![/b][/h1]

[b]ChemLab[/b] (Chemistry Laboratory) is another type of [b]workbench[/b] (part of martian Hab) used to perform and discover new [b]chemical reactions[/b], such as: electrolysis, sabatier reaction, making rocket fuel and others. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kGDxrYt.png[/img]

The laboratory is equipped with chemical fume hood and tools: electrolysis station, the reactor, micro-crusher, lab phials, burner, mixer etc. The workplace is also equipped with a screen that displays formulas of each reaction and instructions. Some of the essential ingredients you will find in the inventory or on the table.  
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iS4hWNN.png[/img]

At the beginning of the game, you will be able to make only basic reactions. As you progress through your Technology Tree you will be able to perform and unlock more chemical reactions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LAkiGn5.gif[/img]

While working in the Chemlab you have to remember about safety and to follow the instructions displayed on the screen. Performing the chemical reactions carelessly can be very dangerous and can cause the damage. For example, if the pressure you set is to high the reactor will explode!

notes.title: Devlog #15: The Workbench
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gIHwJsU.png[/img]

[h1][b]Dear Martians![/b][/h1]

The [b]Workbench[/b] will allow you to repair broken parts of the [b]Printed Circuit Boards[/b] that are used in the electronic equipment available in the game. It is equipped with [b]soldering station[/b] with [b]hot air tool[/b] and [b]soldering iron[/b]. On the workbench you can also find [b]multimeter station[/b] and a case with the new components for the PCBs. 

As part of the [b]Workbench[/b] you will have access to a helping multi-display, which will allow you to zoom and diagnose even the tiniest SMD components.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/F5hShAz.gif[/img]

First step in PCB repair will be desoldering. In order to disassemble the damaged components, you have to melt the solder alloy by using a hot air tool. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aG5pFfA.gif[/img]

Then you can replace a faulty compoment with a new element. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XIinqQy.gif[/img]

Next you can use the soldering iron to solder the new component back into the board. 

Sometimes a PCB will also have broken conductive tracks. They can be fixed by using the soldering station as well. Place the soldering iron on the broken track and put new solder along it’s path. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4emkn9z.gif[/img]

Once the process is done, you can use the multimeter station to check if the connections are fixed and the PCB is repaired. 

---

We will write more details about using the Workbench and the PCBs in future devlogs, so stay tuned for the updates! Keep following us on social media and feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/nscTUpu]discord channel[/url]

Best Regards,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Devlog #14: The Weather: part 3/3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460179/bebb9d8797ff8fa672afa6df758ad16a22fecee1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Dear Martians! [/b][/h1]

Mars is a cold planet and the average temperature is much lower than on Earth. Due to the thin atmosphere of the Red Planet, the significant temperature drop can be observed. 

As we mentioned in previous devlog, fortunately the player has a [b]weather forecast system[/b] which warns about the [b]expected temperature drop[/b] and [b]incoming natural events[/b]. The [b]weather alerts[/b] will be received about an hour before the expected temperature drop or incoming weather phenomenon, so you will have enough time to take shelter inside a base or a heavy rover. 
When the atmospheric temperature is already very low or when the natural event strikes, the warning will appear on the screen. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460179/5afe4c8f19606174e6514aa0eee971fc25690068.png[/img]

Especially the nighttime temperature is dangerously cold so it is important to find shelter immediately!

[h1][b]Dear Martians![/b][/h1]

[b]Spectral Detector[/b] is a tool for detecting resources in rocks and the presence of water in Martian soil. It allows for spectroscopic analysis of rocks and soil to learn about their composition. 

It will also let you measure the amount of surface hydrogen to estimate the volume of water reservoir below it. Additionally [b]Spectral Detector[/b] will acquire information about the rate of water yield and distance to the center of water-rich spot.

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/we1BsgK.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Dear Martians! [/b][/h1]

In today's post we would like you to take a look at a very useful device, which you will get to use on Mars. The detonator is a device that can be used to trigger explosives or ignite solid rocket motors.

notes.title: Devlog #4: Greenhouse
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Martians! [/b][/h1]

One of the most important and also challenging task, will be to establish reliable food source on Mars. In order to achieve this, you will need to grow crops, because plants are the major source of food and oxygen on the Red Planet. You will have to [b]build martian greenhouses [/b]for growing various plants. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460179/598482e75be4a6321e1c6e44f625c80bc83d40bd.png[/img]

[h1][b]Greenhouse[/b][/h1]

[b]Greenhouse[/b] is a large building intended for cultivating plants in controlled environment. It provides required conditions for plant growth, such as: temperature, lighting and irrigation. You can control conditions in the greenhouse using a terminal. Moreover, it can also be used for air revitalization, water recycling, waste recycling and food processing. 

In the [b]greenhouse[/b] you can use two methods of growing plants, such as: [b]hydroponics[/b] (without soil, in hydroponic pot / container filled with water rich in minerals and nutrients) and [b]traditional method - direct to soil[/b]. Plants growing in hydroponic pots or containers, have different needs than plants growing in the soil. You can generate the soil from organic material using the composter. 
The greenhouse also has a[b] folding shield [/b]which helps you protect your crops during solar storms.

[h1][b]Plants cultivation[/b][/h1]

First, start seeds in a small hydroponic pots, which you can find on the side of the greenhouse. When seedlings grow taller, you can plant them directly to the soil, and then to the large containers. Plants need light (for the photosynthesis), carbon dioxide, water and nitrogen. Ideal soil should be rich in Nitrogen, which is a natural fertilizer that help plants grow healthy. If soil doesn’t contain enough nitrogen - plants will grow really slow and weak. 

[b]Greenhouse[/b] is filled with the equipment which will help you with the cultivating, such as: 
[list]
[*] seed planting tool; 
[*] containers and pots; 
[*] hydroponic farm; 
[*] plant incubator;
[*] seed modification device;
[*] organic composter;
[*] terminals for controlling the conditions of a greenhouse.
[/list]

Remember that your plants are quite fragile, you can’t allow the greenhouse to lose pressure, otherwise your food supplies may quickly disappear.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FWTNn8t.gif[/img]

One greenhouse should be enough for a few colonizers, but you will need to build more of them if you want to grow your colony. Later you will also be able to build garden domes, but that’s a story for another time ;) 

If you have any suggestions or topics, which you would like you to read about, feel free to let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/nscTUpu]discord channel[/url]. Keep following us on social media! 

See you next week! ːsteamhappyː
Best Regards, 
Occupy Mars Team
